pokemon.abomasnow.flavor: A powerful Pokémon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.
pokemon.abomasnow.name: Abomasnow
pokemon.abomasnowmega.name: Mega Abomasnow
pokemon.abra.flavor: Spends 18 hours of the day sleeping. Even while asleep, Abra can control its psychic powers—should danger approach, the Pokémon will simply teleport away.
pokemon.abra.name: Abra
pokemon.absol.flavor: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.
pokemon.absol.name: Absol
pokemon.absolmega.name: Mega Absol
pokemon.absolmegaz.name: Mega Absol Z
pokemon.accelgor.flavor: It moves with blinding speed and lobs poison at foes. Featuring Accelgor as a main character is a surefire way to make a movie or comic popular.
pokemon.accelgor.name: Accelgor
pokemon.aegislash.flavor: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a force field of spectral power to reduce the damage of any attack.
pokemon.aegislash.name: Aegislash
pokemon.aegislashblade.name: Blade Aegislash
pokemon.aerodactyl.flavor: This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient times. Apparently even modern technology is incapable of producing a perfectly restored specimen.
pokemon.aerodactyl.name: Aerodactyl
pokemon.aerodactylmega.name: Mega Aerodactyl
pokemon.aggron.flavor: Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by ramming into them horn first.
pokemon.aggron.name: Aggron
pokemon.aggronmega.name: Mega Aggron
pokemon.aipom.flavor: This treetop dweller possesses a tail as dexterous as a hand. Ancient writings describe this Pokémon as a one-armed oddity.
pokemon.aipom.name: Aipom
pokemon.alakazam.flavor: The longer Alakazam lives, the larger and heavier its head becomes. Our tests have shown that the strength of its psychic powers correlates positively to the weight of its head.
pokemon.alakazam.name: Alakazam
pokemon.alakazammega.name: Mega Alakazam
pokemon.alcremie.flavor: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it’s decorated with cream.
pokemon.alcremie.name: Alcremie
pokemon.alcremiegmax.name: Gigantamax Alcremie
pokemon.alomomola.flavor: Fishermen take them along on long voyages, because if you have an Alomomola with you, there’ll be no need for a doctor or medicine.
pokemon.alomomola.name: Alomomola
pokemon.altaria.flavor: As it flies in a calm and relaxed manner, Altaria performs a humming song that would enrapture any audience.
pokemon.altaria.name: Altaria
pokemon.altariamega.name: Mega Altaria
pokemon.amaura.flavor: This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. In the past, it lived with others of its kind in cold lands where there were fewer predators.
pokemon.amaura.name: Amaura
pokemon.ambipom.flavor: To affirm their kinship, members of this species will form a ring by linking their newly doubled tails together. On rare occasions, humans have been accepted into such rings.
pokemon.ambipom.name: Ambipom
pokemon.amoonguss.flavor: This Pokémon puffs poisonous spores at its foes. If the spores aren’t washed off quickly, they’ll grow into mushrooms wherever they land.
pokemon.amoonguss.name: Amoonguss
pokemon.ampharos.flavor: The light from its tail can be seen from space. This is why you can always tell exactly where it is, which is why it usually keeps the light off.
pokemon.ampharos.name: Ampharos
pokemon.ampharosmega.name: Mega Ampharos
pokemon.annihilape.flavor: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.
pokemon.annihilape.name: Annihilape
pokemon.anorith.flavor: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. Anorith lived in the ocean about 100,000,000 years ago, hunting with its pair of claws.
pokemon.anorith.name: Anorith
pokemon.appletun.flavor: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.
pokemon.appletun.name: Appletun
pokemon.appletungmax.name: Gigantamax Appletun
pokemon.applin.flavor: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it’s just an apple and nothing more.
pokemon.applin.name: Applin
pokemon.araquanid.flavor: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can then take its time to savor its meal.
pokemon.araquanid.name: Araquanid
pokemon.araquanidtotem.name: Totem Araquanid
pokemon.arbok.flavor: The frightening patterns on its belly have been studied. Six variations have been confirmed.
pokemon.arbok.name: Arbok
pokemon.arboliva.flavor: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.
pokemon.arboliva.name: Arboliva
pokemon.arcanine.flavor: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.
pokemon.arcanine.name: Arcanine
pokemon.arcaninehisui.name: Hisuian Arcanine
pokemon.arceus.flavor: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.
pokemon.arceus.name: Arceus
pokemon.archaludon.flavor: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.
pokemon.archaludon.name: Archaludon
pokemon.archen.flavor: This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. As research suggested, Archen is unable to fly. But it’s very good at jumping.
pokemon.archen.name: Archen
pokemon.archeops.flavor: It needs a running start to take off. If Archeops wants to fly, it first needs to run nearly 25 mph, building speed over a course of about 2.5 miles.
pokemon.archeops.name: Archeops
pokemon.arctibax.flavor: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.
pokemon.arctibax.name: Arctibax
pokemon.arctovish.flavor: Though it’s able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.
pokemon.arctovish.name: Arctovish
pokemon.arctozolt.flavor: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.
pokemon.arctozolt.name: Arctozolt
pokemon.ariados.flavor: Every night, it wanders around in search of prey, whose movements it restrains by spewing threads before it bites into them with its fangs.
pokemon.ariados.name: Ariados
pokemon.armaldo.flavor: After evolution, this Pokémon emerged onto land. Its lower body has become stronger, and blows from its tail are devastating.
pokemon.armaldo.name: Armaldo
pokemon.armarouge.flavor: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.
pokemon.armarouge.name: Armarouge
pokemon.aromatisse.flavor: The scent that constantly emits from its fur is so powerful that this Pokémon’s companions will eventually lose their sense of smell.
pokemon.aromatisse.name: Aromatisse
pokemon.aron.flavor: It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks— to build up the steel armor that protects its body.
pokemon.aron.name: Aron
pokemon.arrokuda.flavor: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It’s very proud of that jaw.
pokemon.arrokuda.name: Arrokuda
pokemon.articuno.flavor: It’s said that this Pokémon’s beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.
pokemon.articuno.name: Articuno
pokemon.articunogalar.name: Galarian Articuno
pokemon.audino.flavor: Audino’s sense of hearing is superb. Not even a pebble rolling along over a mile away will escape Audino’s ears.
pokemon.audino.name: Audino
pokemon.audinomega.name: Mega Audino
pokemon.aurorus.flavor: Aurorus was restored from a fossil. It’s said that when this Pokémon howls, auroras appear in the night sky.
pokemon.aurorus.name: Aurorus
pokemon.avalugg.flavor: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.
pokemon.avalugg.name: Avalugg
pokemon.avalugghisui.name: Hisuian Avalugg
pokemon.axew.flavor: These Pokémon nest in the ground and use their tusks to crush hard berries. Crushing berries is also how they test each other’s strength.
pokemon.axew.name: Axew
pokemon.azelf.flavor: The dreaded Being of Willpower. Legends tell of this Pokémon manipulating the will of its adversaries and turning them into puppets of its own.
pokemon.azelf.name: Azelf
pokemon.azumarill.flavor: It spends most of its time in the water. On sunny days, Azumarill floats on the surface of the water and sunbathes.
pokemon.azumarill.name: Azumarill
pokemon.azurill.flavor: The ball on Azurill’s tail bounces like a rubber ball, and it’s full of the nutrients the Pokémon needs to grow.
pokemon.azurill.name: Azurill
pokemon.bagon.flavor: Bagon jumps off cliffs every day, trying to grow stronger so that someday it will be able to fly.
pokemon.bagon.name: Bagon
pokemon.baltoy.flavor: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.
pokemon.baltoy.name: Baltoy
pokemon.banette.flavor: It’s a stuffed toy that was thrown away and became possessed, ever searching for the one who threw it away so it can exact its revenge.
pokemon.banette.name: Banette
pokemon.banettemega.name: Mega Banette
pokemon.barbaracle.flavor: Seven Binacle come together to form one Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head gives orders to those serving as the limbs.
pokemon.barbaracle.name: Barbaracle
pokemon.barbaraclemega.name: Mega Barbaracle
pokemon.barboach.flavor: Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.
pokemon.barboach.name: Barboach
pokemon.barraskewda.flavor: This Pokémon has a jaw that’s as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda’s flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.
pokemon.barraskewda.name: Barraskewda
pokemon.basculegion.flavor: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.
pokemon.basculegion.name: Basculegion
pokemon.basculegionf.name: Female Basculegion
pokemon.basculin.flavor: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.
pokemon.basculin.name: Basculin
pokemon.basculinbluestriped.name: Blue-Striped Basculin
pokemon.basculinwhitestriped.name: White-Striped Basculin
pokemon.bastiodon.flavor: Its face is sturdy—as strong as diamond—and this hardness offers a very stable defense. Much about this species is still unknown, such as its natural habitat.
pokemon.bastiodon.name: Bastiodon
pokemon.baxcalibur.flavor: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.
pokemon.baxcalibur.name: Baxcalibur
pokemon.baxcaliburmega.name: Mega Baxcalibur
pokemon.bayleef.flavor: Bayleef’s neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each tubular leaf is a small shoot of a tree. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.
pokemon.bayleef.name: Bayleef
pokemon.beartic.flavor: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey. From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that are harder than steel.
pokemon.beartic.name: Beartic
pokemon.beautifly.flavor: A colorful and incredibly beautiful but also greedy Pokémon. In an effort to keep its favorite food all to itself, it will chase away Combee as they try to gather nectar.
pokemon.beautifly.name: Beautifly
pokemon.beedrill.flavor: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.
pokemon.beedrill.name: Beedrill
pokemon.beedrillmega.name: Mega Beedrill
pokemon.beheeyem.flavor: Whenever a Beheeyem visits a farm, a Dubwool mysteriously disappears.
pokemon.beheeyem.name: Beheeyem
pokemon.beldum.flavor: From its rear, Beldum emits a magnetic force that rapidly pulls opponents in. They get skewered on Beldum’s sharp claws.
pokemon.beldum.name: Beldum
pokemon.bellibolt.flavor: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.
pokemon.bellibolt.name: Bellibolt
pokemon.bellossom.flavor: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.
pokemon.bellossom.name: Bellossom
pokemon.bellsprout.flavor: Prefers hot and humid places. It ensnares tiny bugs with its vines and devours them.
pokemon.bellsprout.name: Bellsprout
pokemon.bergmite.flavor: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.
pokemon.bergmite.name: Bergmite
pokemon.bewear.flavor: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.
pokemon.bewear.name: Bewear
pokemon.bibarel.flavor: Bibarel fur repels water and is also a fantastic material for heat retention. These Pokémon create dams on rivers to live in.
pokemon.bibarel.name: Bibarel
pokemon.bidoof.flavor: Bidoof has an unsophisticated face and is rarely flustered by anything. There have been incidents involving Bidoof sauntering into villages and gnawing on the houses without a single care.
pokemon.bidoof.name: Bidoof
pokemon.binacle.flavor: After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they adhere themselves to it and live together. They cooperate to gather food during high tide.
pokemon.binacle.name: Binacle
pokemon.bisharp.flavor: It’s accompanied by a large retinue of Pawniard. Bisharp keeps a keen eye on its minions, ensuring none of them even think of double-crossing it.
pokemon.bisharp.name: Bisharp
pokemon.blacephalon.flavor: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It’s apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.
pokemon.blacephalon.name: Blacephalon
pokemon.blastoise.flavor: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.
pokemon.blastoise.name: Blastoise
pokemon.blastoisegmax.name: Gigantamax Blastoise
pokemon.blastoisemega.name: Mega Blastoise
pokemon.blaziken.flavor: In battle, Blaziken blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this Pokémon’s wrists burn.
pokemon.blaziken.name: Blaziken
pokemon.blazikenmega.name: Mega Blaziken
pokemon.blipbug.flavor: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn’t.
pokemon.blipbug.name: Blipbug
pokemon.blissey.flavor: A kindhearted Pokémon that will care for any sick person or Pokémon until their health improves. The eggs it lays are delicious and bring good fortune to those who eat them.
pokemon.blissey.name: Blissey
pokemon.blitzle.flavor: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.
pokemon.blitzle.name: Blitzle
pokemon.boldore.flavor: If you see its orange crystals start to glow, be wary. It’s about to fire off bursts of energy.
pokemon.boldore.name: Boldore
pokemon.boltund.flavor: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.
pokemon.boltund.name: Boltund
pokemon.bombirdier.flavor: It gathers things up in an apron made from shed feathers added to the Pokémon’s chest feathers, then drops those things from high places for fun.
pokemon.bombirdier.name: Bombirdier
pokemon.bonsly.flavor: Its tears elicit sympathy from those who see them, but do not be deceived! This expulsion of body water is merely a physiological mechanism for keeping itself in good health.
pokemon.bonsly.name: Bonsly
pokemon.bouffalant.flavor: These Pokémon can crush a car with no more than a headbutt. Bouffalant with more hair on their heads hold higher positions within the herd.
pokemon.bouffalant.name: Bouffalant
pokemon.bounsweet.flavor: Its body gives off a sweet, fruity scent that is extremely appetizing to bird Pokémon.
pokemon.bounsweet.name: Bounsweet
pokemon.braixen.flavor: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.
pokemon.braixen.name: Braixen
pokemon.brambleghast.flavor: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.
pokemon.brambleghast.name: Brambleghast
pokemon.bramblin.flavor: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.
pokemon.bramblin.name: Bramblin
pokemon.braviary.flavor: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.
pokemon.braviary.name: Braviary
pokemon.braviaryhisui.name: Hisuian Braviary
pokemon.breloom.flavor: Breloom closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This Pokémon’s fighting technique puts boxers to shame.
pokemon.breloom.name: Breloom
pokemon.brionne.flavor: As if dancing, it artfully dodges the attacks of its enemies. All the while, it’s busy forming a bunch of balloons to overwhelm its foes.
pokemon.brionne.name: Brionne
pokemon.bronzong.flavor: Some believe that its bell-like cry opens holes to another world. It has been revered as a deity since ancient times.
pokemon.bronzong.name: Bronzong
pokemon.bronzor.flavor: Floats using a mysterious energy. The pattern engraved upon its back is held as sacred and can sometimes be found in imagery from ancient cemeteries and other such timeworn places.
pokemon.bronzor.name: Bronzor
pokemon.brutebonnet.flavor: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.
pokemon.brutebonnet.name: Brute Bonnet
pokemon.bruxish.flavor: It burrows beneath the sand, radiating psychic power from the protuberance on its head. It waits for prey as it surveys the area.
pokemon.bruxish.name: Bruxish
pokemon.budew.flavor: When the sun's light strengthens, the bud atop this Pokémon's head opens. This is a sign to the people that the harsh winter is over, and the season of budding has begun.
pokemon.budew.name: Budew
pokemon.buizel.flavor: It moves freely in the water by spinning its forked tail for propulsion. The resemblance to the screw of a steamboat is coincidental.
pokemon.buizel.name: Buizel
pokemon.bulbasaur.flavor: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.
pokemon.bulbasaur.name: Bulbasaur
pokemon.buneary.flavor: My hypothesis as to why Buneary rolls up its ears is that its hearing is far too keen. I surmise that the Pokémon protects its hearing by limiting the sound that may enter its ears.
pokemon.buneary.name: Buneary
pokemon.bunnelby.flavor: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.
pokemon.bunnelby.name: Bunnelby
pokemon.burmy.flavor: If its cloak is even slightly damaged, Burmy will immediately repair it with whatever is close at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.
pokemon.burmy.name: Burmy
pokemon.butterfree.flavor: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.
pokemon.butterfree.name: Butterfree
pokemon.butterfreegmax.name: Gigantamax Butterfree
pokemon.buzzwole.flavor: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
pokemon.buzzwole.name: Buzzwole
pokemon.cacnea.flavor: Cacnea lives in arid locations such as deserts. It releases a strong aroma from its flower to attract prey. When prey comes near, this Pokémon shoots sharp thorns from its body to bring the victim down.
pokemon.cacnea.name: Cacnea
pokemon.cacturne.flavor: During the daytime, Cacturne remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun. This Pokémon becomes active at night when the temperature drops.
pokemon.cacturne.name: Cacturne
pokemon.calyrex.flavor: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.
pokemon.calyrex.name: Calyrex
pokemon.calyrexice.name: Ice Calyrex
pokemon.calyrexshadow.name: Shadow Calyrex
pokemon.camerupt.flavor: Camerupt has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this Pokémon’s back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.
pokemon.camerupt.name: Camerupt
pokemon.cameruptmega.name: Mega Camerupt
pokemon.capsakid.flavor: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.
pokemon.capsakid.name: Capsakid
pokemon.carbink.flavor: When beset by attackers, Carbink wipes them all out by firing high-energy beams from the gems embedded in its body.
pokemon.carbink.name: Carbink
pokemon.carkol.flavor: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.
pokemon.carkol.name: Carkol
pokemon.carnivine.flavor: Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.
pokemon.carnivine.name: Carnivine
pokemon.carracosta.flavor: Carracosta completely devours its prey—bones, shells, and all. Because of this, Carracosta’s own shell grows thick and sturdy.
pokemon.carracosta.name: Carracosta
pokemon.carvanha.flavor: It won’t attack while it’s alone—not even if it spots prey. Instead, it waits for other Carvanha to join it, and then the Pokémon attack as a group.
pokemon.carvanha.name: Carvanha
pokemon.cascoon.flavor: The silk coating its body is thin but sufficiently strong. Cascoon's silk has a luster and texture superior to that of Silcoon's, and clothes made using Cascoon silk are regarded as top-notch.
pokemon.cascoon.name: Cascoon
pokemon.castform.flavor: Although its form changes with the weather, that is apparently the result of a chemical reaction and not the result of its own free will.
pokemon.castform.name: Castform
pokemon.castformrainy.name: Rainy Castform
pokemon.castformsnowy.name: Snowy Castform
pokemon.castformsunny.name: Sunny Castform
pokemon.caterpie.flavor: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.
pokemon.caterpie.name: Caterpie
pokemon.celebi.flavor: This Pokémon has the ability to move through time. Records describing it as a forest deity can be found from many different eras.
pokemon.celebi.name: Celebi
pokemon.celesteela.flavor: One of the dangerous UBs, high energy readings can be detected coming from both of its huge arms.
pokemon.celesteela.name: Celesteela
pokemon.centiskorch.flavor: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.
pokemon.centiskorch.name: Centiskorch
pokemon.centiskorchgmax.name: Gigantamax Centiskorch
pokemon.ceruledge.flavor: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.
pokemon.ceruledge.name: Ceruledge
pokemon.cetitan.flavor: This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with powerful muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.
pokemon.cetitan.name: Cetitan
pokemon.cetoddle.flavor: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.
pokemon.cetoddle.name: Cetoddle
pokemon.chandelure.flavor: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.
pokemon.chandelure.name: Chandelure
pokemon.chandeluremega.name: Mega Chandelure
pokemon.chansey.flavor: This purehearted Pokémon shares its eggs with the injured.
pokemon.chansey.name: Chansey
pokemon.charcadet.flavor: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.
pokemon.charcadet.name: Charcadet
pokemon.charizard.flavor: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.
pokemon.charizard.name: Charizard
pokemon.charizardgmax.name: Gigantamax Charizard
pokemon.charizardmegax.name: Mega Charizard X
pokemon.charizardmegay.name: Mega Charizard Y
pokemon.charjabug.flavor: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.
pokemon.charjabug.name: Charjabug
pokemon.charmander.flavor: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.
pokemon.charmander.name: Charmander
pokemon.charmeleon.flavor: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.
pokemon.charmeleon.name: Charmeleon
pokemon.chatot.flavor: A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.
pokemon.chatot.name: Chatot
pokemon.cherrim.flavor: Motionless, save for the occasional quiver. A rich array of Pokémon can be found gathered around it, drawn by the scent exuded from Cherrim's folded petals.
pokemon.cherrim.name: Cherrim
pokemon.cherubi.flavor: Once the fruit growing alongside the main body is large and plump, Cherubi will use the nutrients within to evolve. The fruit then detaches, becoming nourishment for other creatures.
pokemon.cherubi.name: Cherubi
pokemon.chesnaught.flavor: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.
pokemon.chesnaught.name: Chesnaught
pokemon.chesnaughtmega.name: Mega Chesnaught
pokemon.chespin.flavor: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
pokemon.chespin.name: Chespin
pokemon.chewtle.flavor: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.
pokemon.chewtle.name: Chewtle
pokemon.chienpao.flavor: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.
pokemon.chienpao.name: Chien-Pao
pokemon.chikorita.flavor: In battle, Chikorita waves its leaf around to keep the foe at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, becalming the battling Pokémon and creating a cozy, friendly atmosphere all around.
pokemon.chikorita.name: Chikorita
pokemon.chimchar.flavor: Full of vigor and always in high spirits. It was once known by the name ”Lantern-Tail” and feared as some kind of apparition.
pokemon.chimchar.name: Chimchar
pokemon.chimecho.flavor: Can emit waves of air powerful enough to knock out prey taller than itself. I hypothesize that it amplifies the faint sound of wind within its body.
pokemon.chimecho.name: Chimecho
pokemon.chimechomega.name: Mega Chimecho
pokemon.chinchou.flavor: Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.
pokemon.chinchou.name: Chinchou
pokemon.chingling.flavor: This Pokémon gave me an excruciating headache when it seemingly cried out without making a sound. Perhaps there are some sounds that the human ear is simply incapable of hearing.
pokemon.chingling.name: Chingling
pokemon.chiyu.flavor: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.
pokemon.chiyu.name: Chi-Yu
pokemon.cinccino.flavor: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won’t tolerate even a speck of the stuff.
pokemon.cinccino.name: Cinccino
pokemon.cinderace.flavor: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.
pokemon.cinderace.name: Cinderace
pokemon.cinderacegmax.name: Gigantamax Cinderace
pokemon.clamperl.flavor: Despite its appearance, it’s carnivorous. It clamps down on its prey with both sides of its shell and doesn’t let go until they stop moving.
pokemon.clamperl.name: Clamperl
pokemon.clauncher.flavor: Clauncher’s claws can fall off during battle, but they’ll regenerate. The meat inside the claws is popular as a delicacy in Galar.
pokemon.clauncher.name: Clauncher
pokemon.clawitzer.flavor: After using the feelers on its oversized claw to detect the location of prey, Clawitzer launches a cannonball of water at its target.
pokemon.clawitzer.name: Clawitzer
pokemon.claydol.flavor: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.
pokemon.claydol.name: Claydol
pokemon.clefable.flavor: Legend says that on clear, quiet nights, it listens for the voices of its kin living on the moon. I, too, often think of my homeland, so far away.
pokemon.clefable.name: Clefable
pokemon.clefablemega.name: Mega Clefable
pokemon.clefairy.flavor: It can be found in quiet mountain areas on a full moon's night. Its dancing and its tiny, faintly glowing wings confer upon it a lovely fairylike quality.
pokemon.clefairy.name: Clefairy
pokemon.cleffa.flavor: In silhouette, they resemble twinkling starlight. When shooting stars rain from the night sky, Cleffa gather in numbers and dance as though they are indeed incarnations of the stars.
pokemon.cleffa.name: Cleffa
pokemon.clobbopus.flavor: It’s very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.
pokemon.clobbopus.name: Clobbopus
pokemon.clodsire.flavor: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It’s a risky move that puts everything on the line.
pokemon.clodsire.name: Clodsire
pokemon.cloyster.flavor: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.
pokemon.cloyster.name: Cloyster
pokemon.coalossal.flavor: It’s usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokemon.coalossal.name: Coalossal
pokemon.coalossalgmax.name: Gigantamax Coalossal
pokemon.cobalion.flavor: This Pokémon appears in a legend alongside Terrakion and Virizion, fighting against humans in defense of the Unova region’s Pokémon.
pokemon.cobalion.name: Cobalion
pokemon.cofagrigus.flavor: This Pokémon has a body of sparkling gold. People say it no longer remembers that it was once human.
pokemon.cofagrigus.name: Cofagrigus
pokemon.combee.flavor: They swear fealty to a queen Pokémon and work diligently to gather nectar. Each swarm produces a different flavor of honey.
pokemon.combee.name: Combee
pokemon.combusken.flavor: Combusken toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. This Pokémon’s legs possess both speed and power, enabling it to dole out 10 kicks in one second.
pokemon.combusken.name: Combusken
pokemon.comfey.flavor: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won’t wither once they’re attached to a Comfey.
pokemon.comfey.name: Comfey
pokemon.conkeldurr.flavor: Concrete mixed by Conkeldurr is much more durable than normal concrete, even when the compositions of the two materials are the same.
pokemon.conkeldurr.name: Conkeldurr
pokemon.copperajah.flavor: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.
pokemon.copperajah.name: Copperajah
pokemon.copperajahgmax.name: Gigantamax Copperajah
pokemon.corphish.flavor: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.
pokemon.corphish.name: Corphish
pokemon.corsola.flavor: It will regrow any branches that break off its head. People keep particularly beautiful Corsola branches as charms to promote safe childbirth.
pokemon.corsola.name: Corsola
pokemon.corsolagalar.name: Galarian Corsola
pokemon.corviknight.flavor: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.
pokemon.corviknight.name: Corviknight
pokemon.corviknightgmax.name: Gigantamax Corviknight
pokemon.corvisquire.flavor: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.
pokemon.corvisquire.name: Corvisquire
pokemon.cosmoem.flavor: The absorption of starlight fuels this Pokémon’s growth. The shell that encases it is harder than any known material.
pokemon.cosmoem.name: Cosmoem
pokemon.cosmog.flavor: This Pokémon came from another universe. Its gaseous body is so light that even a gentle breeze can blow it away.
pokemon.cosmog.name: Cosmog
pokemon.cottonee.flavor: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.
pokemon.cottonee.name: Cottonee
pokemon.crabominable.flavor: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!
pokemon.crabominable.name: Crabominable
pokemon.crabominablemega.name: Mega Crabominable
pokemon.crabrawler.flavor: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.
pokemon.crabrawler.name: Crabrawler
pokemon.cradily.flavor: It has short legs and can’t walk very fast, but its neck and tentacles can extend to over three times their usual length to nab distant prey.
pokemon.cradily.name: Cradily
pokemon.cramorant.flavor: It’s so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it’s battling midfight.
pokemon.cramorant.name: Cramorant
pokemon.cramorantgorging.name: Gorging Cramorant
pokemon.cramorantgulping.name: Gulping Cramorant
pokemon.cranidos.flavor: An incredibly rare sight. They duel each other by ramming their heads together, and the resulting sound echoes throughout the area like the pealing of a bell.
pokemon.cranidos.name: Cranidos
pokemon.crawdaunt.flavor: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.
pokemon.crawdaunt.name: Crawdaunt
pokemon.cresselia.flavor: Cresselia is reminiscent of the crescent moon. It leaves a brilliant line of light in its wake as it flies across the night sky. I daresay it resembles the heavenly maiden who created the Milky Way.
pokemon.cresselia.name: Cresselia
pokemon.croagunk.flavor: A poison wielder with a dastardly personality. Despite such qualities, this species is afforded a measure of popularity due to its peculiar cry and comical features.
pokemon.croagunk.name: Croagunk
pokemon.crobat.flavor: Its hind limbs have become another set of wings. Crobat expertly maneuvers its four wings to dart in exquisite fashion through even the most confined caves without losing any speed.
pokemon.crobat.name: Crobat
pokemon.crocalor.flavor: The combination of Crocalor’s fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon’s head.
pokemon.crocalor.name: Crocalor
pokemon.croconaw.flavor: Once Croconaw has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.
pokemon.croconaw.name: Croconaw
pokemon.crustle.flavor: This highly territorial Pokémon prefers dry climates. It won’t come out of its boulder on rainy days.
pokemon.crustle.name: Crustle
pokemon.cryogonal.flavor: With its icy chains, Cryogonal freezes those it encounters. It then takes its victims away to somewhere unknown.
pokemon.cryogonal.name: Cryogonal
pokemon.cubchoo.flavor: When this Pokémon is in good health, its snot becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot on anyone it doesn’t like.
pokemon.cubchoo.name: Cubchoo
pokemon.cubone.flavor: When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.
pokemon.cubone.name: Cubone
pokemon.cufant.flavor: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It’s also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.
pokemon.cufant.name: Cufant
pokemon.cursola.flavor: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon’s core spirit.
pokemon.cursola.name: Cursola
pokemon.cutiefly.flavor: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. You can find Cutiefly hovering around Gossifleur, trying to get some of Gossifleur’s pollen.
pokemon.cutiefly.name: Cutiefly
pokemon.cyclizar.flavor: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.
pokemon.cyclizar.name: Cyclizar
pokemon.cyndaquil.flavor: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.
pokemon.cyndaquil.name: Cyndaquil
pokemon.dachsbun.flavor: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon’s body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.
pokemon.dachsbun.name: Dachsbun
pokemon.darkrai.flavor: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.
pokemon.darkrai.name: Darkrai
pokemon.darkraimega.name: Mega Darkrai
pokemon.darmanitan.flavor: The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokémon can deliver punches capable of obliterating a dump truck.
pokemon.darmanitan.name: Darmanitan
pokemon.darmanitangalar.name: Standard Galarian Darmanitan
pokemon.darmanitangalarzen.name: Zen Galarian Darmanitan
pokemon.darmanitanzen.name: Zen Darmanitan
pokemon.dartrix.flavor: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.
pokemon.dartrix.name: Dartrix
pokemon.darumaka.flavor: It derives its power from fire burning inside its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokémon will immediately fall asleep.
pokemon.darumaka.name: Darumaka
pokemon.darumakagalar.name: Galarian Darumaka
pokemon.decidueye.flavor: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.
pokemon.decidueye.name: Decidueye
pokemon.decidueyehisui.name: Hisuian Decidueye
pokemon.dedenne.flavor: A Dedenne’s whiskers pick up electrical waves other Dedenne send out. These Pokémon share locations of food or electricity with one another.
pokemon.dedenne.name: Dedenne
pokemon.deerling.flavor: Their coloring changes according to the seasons and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.
pokemon.deerling.name: Deerling
pokemon.deino.flavor: When it encounters something, its first urge is usually to bite it. If it likes what it tastes, it will commit the associated scent to memory.
pokemon.deino.name: Deino
pokemon.delcatty.flavor: Delcatty prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this Pokémon eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.
pokemon.delcatty.name: Delcatty
pokemon.delibird.flavor: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.
pokemon.delibird.name: Delibird
pokemon.delphox.flavor: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
pokemon.delphox.name: Delphox
pokemon.delphoxmega.name: Mega Delphox
pokemon.deoxys.flavor: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in Deoxys. The crystalline organ on this Pokémon’s chest appears to be its brain.
pokemon.deoxys.name: Deoxys
pokemon.deoxysattack.name: Attack Deoxys
pokemon.deoxysdefense.name: Defense Deoxys
pokemon.deoxysspeed.name: Speed Deoxys
pokemon.dewgong.flavor: Its entire body is a snowy white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.
pokemon.dewgong.name: Dewgong
pokemon.dewott.flavor: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.
pokemon.dewott.name: Dewott
pokemon.dewpider.flavor: It forms a water bubble at the rear of its body and then covers its head with it. Meeting another Dewpider means comparing water-bubble sizes.
pokemon.dewpider.name: Dewpider
pokemon.dhelmise.flavor: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.
pokemon.dhelmise.name: Dhelmise
pokemon.dialga.flavor: This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.
pokemon.dialga.name: Dialga
pokemon.dialgaorigin.name: Origin Dialga
pokemon.diancie.flavor: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.
pokemon.diancie.name: Diancie
pokemon.dianciemega.name: Mega Diancie
pokemon.diggersby.flavor: With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It’s a huge help during tunnel construction.
pokemon.diggersby.name: Diggersby
pokemon.diglett.flavor: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.
pokemon.diglett.name: Diglett
pokemon.diglettalola.name: Alolan Diglett
pokemon.dipplin.flavor: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.
pokemon.dipplin.name: Dipplin
pokemon.ditto.flavor: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.
pokemon.ditto.name: Ditto
pokemon.dodrio.flavor: One of Doduo’s two heads splits to form a unique species. It runs close to 40 mph in prairies.
pokemon.dodrio.name: Dodrio
pokemon.doduo.flavor: Its short wings make flying difficult. Instead, this Pokémon runs at high speed on developed legs.
pokemon.doduo.name: Doduo
pokemon.dolliv.flavor: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.
pokemon.dolliv.name: Dolliv
pokemon.dondozo.flavor: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it’s bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.
pokemon.dondozo.name: Dondozo
pokemon.donphan.flavor: Donphan’s favorite attack is curling its body into a ball, then charging at its foe while rolling at high speed. Once it starts rolling, this Pokémon can’t stop very easily.
pokemon.donphan.name: Donphan
pokemon.dottler.flavor: It barely moves, but it’s still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.
pokemon.dottler.name: Dottler
pokemon.doublade.flavor: Honedge evolves into twins. The two blades rub together to emit a metallic sound that unnerves opponents.
pokemon.doublade.name: Doublade
pokemon.dracovish.flavor: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.
pokemon.dracovish.name: Dracovish
pokemon.dracozolt.flavor: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.
pokemon.dracozolt.name: Dracozolt
pokemon.dragalge.flavor: Dragalge uses a poisonous liquid capable of corroding metal to send tankers that enter its territory to the bottom of the sea.
pokemon.dragalge.name: Dragalge
pokemon.dragalgemega.name: Mega Dragalge
pokemon.dragapult.flavor: When it isn’t battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.
pokemon.dragapult.name: Dragapult
pokemon.dragonair.flavor: This Pokémon lives in pristine oceans and lakes. It can control the weather, and it uses this power to fly into the sky, riding on the wind.
pokemon.dragonair.name: Dragonair
pokemon.dragonite.flavor: It’s a kindhearted Pokémon. If it spots a drowning person or Pokémon, Dragonite simply must help them.
pokemon.dragonite.name: Dragonite
pokemon.dragonitemega.name: Mega Dragonite
pokemon.drakloak.flavor: It’s capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.
pokemon.drakloak.name: Drakloak
pokemon.drampa.flavor: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.
pokemon.drampa.name: Drampa
pokemon.drampamega.name: Mega Drampa
pokemon.drapion.flavor: Has a brutish, ferocious temperament. With immense strength and a sturdy shell off which swords will bounce, it rampages about and wreaks havoc.
pokemon.drapion.name: Drapion
pokemon.dratini.flavor: Dratini dwells near bodies of rapidly flowing water, such as the plunge pools of waterfalls. As it grows, Dratini will shed its skin many times.
pokemon.dratini.name: Dratini
pokemon.drednaw.flavor: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.
pokemon.drednaw.name: Drednaw
pokemon.drednawgmax.name: Gigantamax Drednaw
pokemon.dreepy.flavor: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.
pokemon.dreepy.name: Dreepy
pokemon.drifblim.flavor: It drifts along at dusk, perfectly silent. Its transient, melancholy aspect touches some people deeply—every so often, one will come upon a song or poem devoted to Drifblim.
pokemon.drifblim.name: Drifblim
pokemon.drifloon.flavor: Said to lure away young children and carry them off to the afterlife. Some whisper that Drifloon are formed of reincarnated human souls, but these rumors are as yet unconfirmed.
pokemon.drifloon.name: Drifloon
pokemon.drilbur.flavor: It brings its claws together and whirls around at high speed before rushing toward its prey.
pokemon.drilbur.name: Drilbur
pokemon.drizzile.flavor: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.
pokemon.drizzile.name: Drizzile
pokemon.drowzee.flavor: If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.
pokemon.drowzee.name: Drowzee
pokemon.druddigon.flavor: Druddigon lives in caves, but it never skips sunbathing—it won’t be able to move if its body gets too cold.
pokemon.druddigon.name: Druddigon
pokemon.dubwool.flavor: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You’ll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.
pokemon.dubwool.name: Dubwool
pokemon.ducklett.flavor: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.
pokemon.ducklett.name: Ducklett
pokemon.dudunsparce.flavor: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.
pokemon.dudunsparce.name: Dudunsparce
pokemon.dudunsparcethreesegment.name: Three-Segment Form Dudunsparce
pokemon.dugtrio.flavor: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.
pokemon.dugtrio.name: Dugtrio
pokemon.dugtrioalola.name: Alolan Dugtrio
pokemon.dunsparce.flavor: This Pokémon’s tiny wings have some scientists saying that Dunsparce used to fly through the sky in ancient times.
pokemon.dunsparce.name: Dunsparce
pokemon.duosion.flavor: Its psychic power can supposedly cover a range of more than half a mile—but only if its two brains can agree with each other.
pokemon.duosion.name: Duosion
pokemon.duraludon.flavor: Its body resembles polished metal, and it’s both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.
pokemon.duraludon.name: Duraludon
pokemon.duraludongmax.name: Gigantamax Duraludon
pokemon.durant.flavor: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.
pokemon.durant.name: Durant
pokemon.dusclops.flavor: There are rumors that peeking inside its bandage-wrapped body will cause one to get pulled in through the gaps between the bandages, never to return. I've been too scared to verify.
pokemon.dusclops.name: Dusclops
pokemon.dusknoir.flavor: Comes to those whose lives have come to an end and escorts their souls to the afterlife. Known to mistakenly take the souls of those who yet have life left in them, albeit rarely.
pokemon.dusknoir.name: Dusknoir
pokemon.duskull.flavor: I've heard that the children of Hisui all begin to behave once they've been told the story of how this Pokémon roams about before the witching hour to spirit away misbehaving children.
pokemon.duskull.name: Duskull
pokemon.dustox.flavor: Tends to be drawn to bonfires on dark nights. Difficult to chase away from settlements because of the way it scatters highly toxic scales.
pokemon.dustox.name: Dustox
pokemon.dwebble.flavor: When it finds a stone appealing, it creates a hole inside it and uses it as its home. This Pokémon is the natural enemy of Roggenrola and Rolycoly.
pokemon.dwebble.name: Dwebble
pokemon.eelektrik.flavor: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.
pokemon.eelektrik.name: Eelektrik
pokemon.eelektross.flavor: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.
pokemon.eelektross.name: Eelektross
pokemon.eelektrossmega.name: Mega Eelektross
pokemon.eevee.flavor: Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokémon evolution—I'm certain of it.
pokemon.eevee.name: Eevee
pokemon.eeveegmax.name: Gigantamax Eevee
pokemon.eeveestarter.name: Partner Eevee
pokemon.eiscue.flavor: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.
pokemon.eiscue.name: Eiscue
pokemon.eiscuenoice.name: Noice Eiscue
pokemon.ekans.flavor: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.
pokemon.ekans.name: Ekans
pokemon.eldegoss.flavor: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.
pokemon.eldegoss.name: Eldegoss
pokemon.electabuzz.flavor: Feeds on electrical energy. During sudden showers beneath looming thunderclouds, one can observe Electabuzz scaling tall trees, where the Pokémon will then wait for lightning to strike.
pokemon.electabuzz.name: Electabuzz
pokemon.electivire.flavor: Its evolution was induced by an unusual item, and its electrical output rises along with its heart rate. From its tails, it can unleash an electric current measuring 20,000 volts.
pokemon.electivire.name: Electivire
pokemon.electrike.flavor: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.
pokemon.electrike.name: Electrike
pokemon.electrode.flavor: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.
pokemon.electrode.name: Electrode
pokemon.electrodehisui.name: Hisuian Electrode
pokemon.elekid.flavor: They generate electricity by spinning their arms. During a thunderstorm, if one hears the lively voices of children out in the wilderness, what one is actually hearing are the voices of Elekid.
pokemon.elekid.name: Elekid
pokemon.elgyem.flavor: If this Pokémon stands near a TV, strange scenery will appear on the screen. That scenery is said to be from its home.
pokemon.elgyem.name: Elgyem
pokemon.emboar.flavor: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.
pokemon.emboar.name: Emboar
pokemon.emboarmega.name: Mega Emboar
pokemon.emolga.flavor: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.
pokemon.emolga.name: Emolga
pokemon.empoleon.flavor: Since ancient times, it has been revered by the people of Hisui, who call it the Master of the Waves. Its wings are a match for even master-crafted blades.
pokemon.empoleon.name: Empoleon
pokemon.enamorus.flavor: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.
pokemon.enamorus.name: Enamorus
pokemon.enamorustherian.name: Therian Enamorus
pokemon.entei.flavor: Entei embodies the passion of magma. This Pokémon is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It sends up massive bursts of fire that utterly consume all that they touch.
pokemon.entei.name: Entei
pokemon.escavalier.flavor: They use shells they’ve stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They’re very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.
pokemon.escavalier.name: Escavalier
pokemon.espathra.flavor: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.
pokemon.espathra.name: Espathra
pokemon.espeon.flavor: Wields an arcane power with which it can predict the weather and even people's thoughts. When bathed in sunshine, the scarlet orb on its brow glows and builds energy.
pokemon.espeon.name: Espeon
pokemon.espurr.flavor: Though Espurr’s expression never changes, behind that blank stare is an intense struggle to contain its devastating psychic power.
pokemon.espurr.name: Espurr
pokemon.eternatus.flavor: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.
pokemon.eternatus.name: Eternatus
pokemon.eternatuseternamax.name: Eternamax Eternatus
pokemon.excadrill.flavor: It’s not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill’s rampant digging.
pokemon.excadrill.name: Excadrill
pokemon.excadrillmega.name: Mega Excadrill
pokemon.exeggcute.flavor: Though it may look like it’s just a bunch of eggs, it’s a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.
pokemon.exeggcute.name: Exeggcute
pokemon.exeggutor.flavor: Each of Exeggutor’s three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don’t seem to be very interested in one another.
pokemon.exeggutor.name: Exeggutor
pokemon.exeggutoralola.name: Alolan Exeggutor
pokemon.exploud.flavor: In the past, people would use the loud voices of these Pokémon as a means of communication between distant cities.
pokemon.exploud.name: Exploud
pokemon.falinks.flavor: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass’s orders are absolute.
pokemon.falinks.name: Falinks
pokemon.falinksmega.name: Mega Falinks
pokemon.farfetchd.flavor: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.
pokemon.farfetchd.name: Farfetch’d
pokemon.farfetchdgalar.name: Galarian Farfetch’d
pokemon.farigiraf.flavor: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig’s.
pokemon.farigiraf.name: Farigiraf
pokemon.fearow.flavor: A Pokémon that dates back many years. If it senses danger, it flies high and away, instantly.
pokemon.fearow.name: Fearow
pokemon.feebas.flavor: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon’s marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.
pokemon.feebas.name: Feebas
pokemon.fennekin.flavor: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokemon.fennekin.name: Fennekin
pokemon.feraligatr.flavor: Feraligatr intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.
pokemon.feraligatr.name: Feraligatr
pokemon.feraligatrmega.name: Mega Feraligatr
pokemon.ferroseed.flavor: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn’t very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.
pokemon.ferroseed.name: Ferroseed
pokemon.ferrothorn.flavor: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.
pokemon.ferrothorn.name: Ferrothorn
pokemon.fezandipiti.flavor: Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely voice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the chain wrapped around its body.
pokemon.fezandipiti.name: Fezandipiti
pokemon.fidough.flavor: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough’s breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon’s vicinity.
pokemon.fidough.name: Fidough
pokemon.finizen.flavor: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.
pokemon.finizen.name: Finizen
pokemon.finneon.flavor: What a gorgeous sight this Pokémon is as it swims with its long, pink-painted caudal fins fluttering behind it. Finneon's beautiful appearance has led to its nickname: ”finery fish.”
pokemon.finneon.name: Finneon
pokemon.flaaffy.flavor: In the places on its body where fleece doesn’t grow, its skin is rubbery and doesn’t conduct electricity. Those spots are safe to touch.
pokemon.flaaffy.name: Flaaffy
pokemon.flabebe.flavor: It’s not safe without the power of a flower, but it will keep traveling around until it finds one with the color and shape it wants.
pokemon.flabebe.name: Flabébé
pokemon.flamigo.flavor: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.
pokemon.flamigo.name: Flamigo
pokemon.flapple.flavor: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.
pokemon.flapple.name: Flapple
pokemon.flapplegmax.name: Gigantamax Flapple
pokemon.flareon.flavor: Flames burn within a saclike organ inside this Pokémon. When Flareon inhales, these flames grow in intensity, reaching a mighty 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokemon.flareon.name: Flareon
pokemon.fletchinder.flavor: Fletchinder launches embers into the den of its prey. When the prey comes leaping out, Fletchinder’s sharp talons finish it off.
pokemon.fletchinder.name: Fletchinder
pokemon.fletchling.flavor: Its melodious cries are actually warnings. Fletchling will mercilessly peck at anything that enters its territory.
pokemon.fletchling.name: Fletchling
pokemon.flittle.flavor: Flittle’s toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon’s belly.
pokemon.flittle.name: Flittle
pokemon.floatzel.flavor: Has a long, rather splendid flotation sac, which prevents Floatzel from drowning even in stormy seas. One might glimpse this species around fishing hamlets from time to time.
pokemon.floatzel.name: Floatzel
pokemon.floette.flavor: It raises flowers and uses them as weapons. The more gorgeous the blossom, the more power it contains.
pokemon.floette.name: Floette
pokemon.floetteeternal.name: Eternal Floette
pokemon.floettemega.name: Mega Floette
pokemon.floragato.flavor: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.
pokemon.floragato.name: Floragato
pokemon.florges.flavor: It controls the flowers it grows. The petal blizzards that Florges triggers are overwhelming in their beauty and power.
pokemon.florges.name: Florges
pokemon.fluttermane.flavor: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.
pokemon.fluttermane.name: Flutter Mane
pokemon.flygon.flavor: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.
pokemon.flygon.name: Flygon
pokemon.fomantis.flavor: When bathed in sunlight, this Pokémon emits a pleasantly sweet scent, which causes bug Pokémon to gather around it.
pokemon.fomantis.name: Fomantis
pokemon.foongus.flavor: No one knows what the Poké Ball–like pattern on Foongus means or why Foongus has it.
pokemon.foongus.name: Foongus
pokemon.forretress.flavor: When something approaches it, it fires off fragments of its steel shell in attack. This is not a conscious action but a conditioned reflex.
pokemon.forretress.name: Forretress
pokemon.fraxure.flavor: After battle, this Pokémon carefully sharpens its tusks on river rocks. It needs to take care of its tusks—if one breaks, it will never grow back.
pokemon.fraxure.name: Fraxure
pokemon.frigibax.flavor: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.
pokemon.frigibax.name: Frigibax
pokemon.frillish.flavor: It envelops its prey in its veillike arms and draws it down to the deeps, five miles below the ocean’s surface.
pokemon.frillish.name: Frillish
pokemon.froakie.flavor: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.
pokemon.froakie.name: Froakie
pokemon.frogadier.flavor: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
pokemon.frogadier.name: Frogadier
pokemon.froslass.flavor: A Pokémon inhabited by the soul of a woman who died bearing a grudge in the snowy mountains. Legends of Froslass placing deathly curses on misbehaving men send shivers down my spine.
pokemon.froslass.name: Froslass
pokemon.froslassmega.name: Mega Froslass
pokemon.frosmoth.flavor: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than −290 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokemon.frosmoth.name: Frosmoth
pokemon.fuecoco.flavor: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.
pokemon.fuecoco.name: Fuecoco
pokemon.furfrou.flavor: There was an era when aristocrats would compete to see who could trim their Furfrou’s fur into the most exquisite style.
pokemon.furfrou.name: Furfrou
pokemon.furret.flavor: Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this Pokémon is very nimble and fleet.
pokemon.furret.name: Furret
pokemon.gabite.flavor: Though Gabite are usually of a violent disposition, when I gave one a glass bead it had been eyeing covetously, it suddenly became quite docile.
pokemon.gabite.name: Gabite
pokemon.gallade.flavor: The blades extending from its elbows are sharper than the finest swords. Its swordsmanship, albeit self-taught, is astonishingly impressive.
pokemon.gallade.name: Gallade
pokemon.gallademega.name: Mega Gallade
pokemon.galvantula.flavor: It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.
pokemon.galvantula.name: Galvantula
pokemon.garbodor.flavor: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.
pokemon.garbodor.name: Garbodor
pokemon.garbodorgmax.name: Gigantamax Garbodor
pokemon.garchomp.flavor: Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.
pokemon.garchomp.name: Garchomp
pokemon.garchompmega.name: Mega Garchomp
pokemon.garchompmegaz.name: Mega Garchomp Z
pokemon.gardevoir.flavor: It will dedicate itself to defending a master it has come to adore. Its pure white dress, reminiscent of those worn by ladies of nobility, is the dress of one who is willing to risk their life.
pokemon.gardevoir.name: Gardevoir
pokemon.gardevoirmega.name: Mega Gardevoir
pokemon.garganacl.flavor: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.
pokemon.garganacl.name: Garganacl
pokemon.gastly.flavor: Gaseous and completely impalpable. Also highly dangerous— inhaling part of its poisonous body will cause one to faint instantly.
pokemon.gastly.name: Gastly
pokemon.gastrodon.flavor: Eats beach sand for nourishment. Should one Gastrodon encounter another of a different color, a fierce battle will inevitably ensue.
pokemon.gastrodon.name: Gastrodon
pokemon.genesect.flavor: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.
pokemon.genesect.name: Genesect
pokemon.gengar.flavor: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!
pokemon.gengar.name: Gengar
pokemon.gengargmax.name: Gigantamax Gengar
pokemon.gengarmega.name: Mega Gengar
pokemon.geodude.flavor: Makes its home in mountainous regions, using its arms to climb along harsh mountain roads. Can be troublesome—carelessly kicking one will cause it to fly into a rage and chase after you.
pokemon.geodude.name: Geodude
pokemon.geodudealola.name: Alolan Geodude
pokemon.gholdengo.flavor: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.
pokemon.gholdengo.name: Gholdengo
pokemon.gible.flavor: It nests in caves untouched by sunlight. Its sharp teeth may fall out when worn away or after an impact, but they regrow within a few days.
pokemon.gible.name: Gible
pokemon.gigalith.flavor: This hardy Pokémon can often be found on construction sites and in mines, working alongside people and Copperajah.
pokemon.gigalith.name: Gigalith
pokemon.gimmighoul.flavor: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.
pokemon.gimmighoul.name: Gimmighoul
pokemon.gimmighoulroaming.name: Roaming Form Gimmighoul
pokemon.girafarig.flavor: Girafarig’s rear head also has a brain, but it is small. The rear head attacks in response to smells and sounds. Approaching this Pokémon from behind can cause the rear head to suddenly lash out and bite.
pokemon.girafarig.name: Girafarig
pokemon.giratina.flavor: There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.
pokemon.giratina.name: Giratina
pokemon.giratinaorigin.name: Origin Giratina
pokemon.glaceon.flavor: Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.
pokemon.glaceon.name: Glaceon
pokemon.glalie.flavor: It covers its body with an armor of ice harder than steel. Uses its breath to freeze prey, which it then devours as if they were frozen desserts.
pokemon.glalie.name: Glalie
pokemon.glaliemega.name: Mega Glalie
pokemon.glameow.flavor: Bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.
pokemon.glameow.name: Glameow
pokemon.glastrier.flavor: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.
pokemon.glastrier.name: Glastrier
pokemon.gligar.flavor: Its tail is tipped by a thick, horrible stinger. To bring down prey, it will first obscure their vision by covering their faces with its body, and then it will use the stinger to inject them with venom.
pokemon.gligar.name: Gligar
pokemon.glimmet.flavor: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.
pokemon.glimmet.name: Glimmet
pokemon.glimmora.flavor: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.
pokemon.glimmora.name: Glimmora
pokemon.glimmoramega.name: Mega Glimmora
pokemon.gliscor.flavor: It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.
pokemon.gliscor.name: Gliscor
pokemon.gloom.flavor: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.
pokemon.gloom.name: Gloom
pokemon.gogoat.flavor: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.
pokemon.gogoat.name: Gogoat
pokemon.golbat.flavor: It sinks its sharp fangs into other creatures and slurps up their blood. A closer look at the fangs reveals that they are hollow and akin to straws.
pokemon.golbat.name: Golbat
pokemon.goldeen.flavor: Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.
pokemon.goldeen.name: Goldeen
pokemon.golduck.flavor: Its body is strong, and it has webbing on its hands and feet. Golduck can swim easily through rough seas, clawing its way through the high waves.
pokemon.golduck.name: Golduck
pokemon.golem.flavor: The rocklike shell is shed each year. The cast-off shell then crumbles, reverting to a mass of soil, which can be spread across fields to promote crop growth.
pokemon.golem.name: Golem
pokemon.golemalola.name: Alolan Golem
pokemon.golett.flavor: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.
pokemon.golett.name: Golett
pokemon.golisopod.flavor: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.
pokemon.golisopod.name: Golisopod
pokemon.golisopodmega.name: Mega Golisopod
pokemon.golurk.flavor: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.
pokemon.golurk.name: Golurk
pokemon.golurkmega.name: Mega Golurk
pokemon.goodra.flavor: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.
pokemon.goodra.name: Goodra
pokemon.goodrahisui.name: Hisuian Goodra
pokemon.goomy.flavor: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.
pokemon.goomy.name: Goomy
pokemon.gorebyss.flavor: The color of its body changes with the water temperature. The coloration of Gorebyss in Alola is almost blindingly vivid.
pokemon.gorebyss.name: Gorebyss
pokemon.gossifleur.flavor: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.
pokemon.gossifleur.name: Gossifleur
pokemon.gothita.flavor: Though they’re still only babies, there’s psychic power stored in their ribbonlike feelers, and sometimes they use that power to fight.
pokemon.gothita.name: Gothita
pokemon.gothitelle.flavor: It has tremendous psychic power, but it dislikes conflict. It’s also able to predict the future based on the movement of the stars.
pokemon.gothitelle.name: Gothitelle
pokemon.gothorita.flavor: It’s said that when stars shine in the night sky, this Pokémon will spirit away sleeping children. Some call it the Witch of Punishment.
pokemon.gothorita.name: Gothorita
pokemon.gougingfire.flavor: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.
pokemon.gougingfire.name: Gouging Fire
pokemon.gourgeist.flavor: Eerie cries emanate from its body in the dead of night. The sounds are said to be the wails of spirits who are suffering in the afterlife.
pokemon.gourgeist.name: Gourgeist
pokemon.gourgeistlarge.name: Large Gourgeist
pokemon.gourgeistsmall.name: Small Gourgeist
pokemon.gourgeistsuper.name: Super Gourgeist
pokemon.grafaiai.flavor: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.
pokemon.grafaiai.name: Grafaiai
pokemon.granbull.flavor: While it has powerful jaws, it doesn’t care for disputes, so it rarely has a chance to display their might.
pokemon.granbull.name: Granbull
pokemon.grapploct.flavor: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.
pokemon.grapploct.name: Grapploct
pokemon.graveler.flavor: Dwells in holes dug into sheer walls of stone. It enjoys rolling down slopes as though it were a boulder during a rockfall, so keep an eye upward while traversing mountain roads.
pokemon.graveler.name: Graveler
pokemon.graveleralola.name: Alolan Graveler
pokemon.greattusk.flavor: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.
pokemon.greattusk.name: Great Tusk
pokemon.greavard.flavor: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.
pokemon.greavard.name: Greavard
pokemon.greedent.flavor: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn’t notice the loss.
pokemon.greedent.name: Greedent
pokemon.greninja.flavor: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
pokemon.greninja.name: Greninja
pokemon.greninjaash.name: Ash’s Greninja
pokemon.greninjabond.name: Battle Bond Greninja
pokemon.greninjamega.name: Mega Greninja
pokemon.grimer.flavor: Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won’t grow in its path.
pokemon.grimer.name: Grimer
pokemon.grimeralola.name: Alolan Grimer
pokemon.grimmsnarl.flavor: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.
pokemon.grimmsnarl.name: Grimmsnarl
pokemon.grimmsnarlgmax.name: Gigantamax Grimmsnarl
pokemon.grookey.flavor: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.
pokemon.grookey.name: Grookey
pokemon.grotle.flavor: Appears where there is clean spring water. The fruit that grows on the shrubs on its shell is sweet, nutritious, and truly delicious.
pokemon.grotle.name: Grotle
pokemon.groudon.flavor: Groudon is said to be the personification of the land itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Kyogre, as each sought to gain the power of nature.
pokemon.groudon.name: Groudon
pokemon.groudonprimal.name: Primal Groudon
pokemon.grovyle.flavor: The leaves growing out of Grovyle’s body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest. This Pokémon is a master at climbing trees in jungles.
pokemon.grovyle.name: Grovyle
pokemon.growlithe.flavor: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.
pokemon.growlithe.name: Growlithe
pokemon.growlithehisui.name: Hisuian Growlithe
pokemon.grubbin.flavor: Its natural enemies, like Rookidee, may flee rather than risk getting caught in its large mandibles that can snap thick tree branches.
pokemon.grubbin.name: Grubbin
pokemon.grumpig.flavor: Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power waves for gaining total control over its foe. When this Pokémon uses its special power, its snorting breath grows labored.
pokemon.grumpig.name: Grumpig
pokemon.gulpin.flavor: Virtually all of Gulpin’s body is its stomach. As a result, it can swallow something its own size. This Pokémon’s stomach contains a special fluid that digests anything.
pokemon.gulpin.name: Gulpin
pokemon.gumshoos.flavor: Although it wasn’t originally found in Alola, this Pokémon was brought over a long time ago when there was a huge Rattata outbreak.
pokemon.gumshoos.name: Gumshoos
pokemon.gumshoostotem.name: Totem Gumshoos
pokemon.gurdurr.flavor: It shows off its muscles to Machoke and other Gurdurr. If it fails to measure up to the other Pokémon, it lies low for a little while.
pokemon.gurdurr.name: Gurdurr
pokemon.guzzlord.flavor: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
pokemon.guzzlord.name: Guzzlord
pokemon.gyarados.flavor: I suspect this Pokémon to be the true identity of a dragon written of in ancient texts, which claimed that it razed an entire village with white-hot beams from its maw.
pokemon.gyarados.name: Gyarados
pokemon.gyaradosmega.name: Mega Gyarados
pokemon.hakamoo.flavor: The scaleless, scarred parts of its body are signs of its strength. It shows them off to defeated opponents.
pokemon.hakamoo.name: Hakamo-o
pokemon.happiny.flavor: In imitation of Chansey, it keeps a round stone tucked into its belly pouch and cherishes it dearly. It gets along well with children and will sometimes play house with them for fun.
pokemon.happiny.name: Happiny
pokemon.hariyama.flavor: Although they enjoy comparing their strength, they’re also kind. They value etiquette, praising opponents they battle.
pokemon.hariyama.name: Hariyama
pokemon.hatenna.flavor: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures’ emotions. If you don’t have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.
pokemon.hatenna.name: Hatenna
pokemon.hatterene.flavor: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.
pokemon.hatterene.name: Hatterene
pokemon.hatterenegmax.name: Gigantamax Hatterene
pokemon.hattrem.flavor: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.
pokemon.hattrem.name: Hattrem
pokemon.haunter.flavor: This frightful, malevolent spirit can glide through walls, appearing wherever it likes. According to rumor, victims of a Haunter's lick will wither to death day by day.
pokemon.haunter.name: Haunter
pokemon.hawlucha.flavor: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.
pokemon.hawlucha.name: Hawlucha
pokemon.hawluchamega.name: Mega Hawlucha
pokemon.haxorus.flavor: Its resilient tusks are its pride and joy. It licks up dirt to take in the minerals it needs to keep its tusks in top condition.
pokemon.haxorus.name: Haxorus
pokemon.heatmor.flavor: There’s a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.
pokemon.heatmor.name: Heatmor
pokemon.heatran.flavor: Stories tell of this Pokémon being birthed from the boiling magma within Mount Coronet. Its molten-steel body holds many mysteries.
pokemon.heatran.name: Heatran
pokemon.heatranmega.name: Mega Heatran
