pokemon.heliolisk.flavor: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.
pokemon.heliolisk.name: Heliolisk
pokemon.helioptile.flavor: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon’s electric moves.
pokemon.helioptile.name: Helioptile
pokemon.heracross.flavor: This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.
pokemon.heracross.name: Heracross
pokemon.heracrossmega.name: Mega Heracross
pokemon.herdier.flavor: Herdier is a very smart and friendly Pokémon. So much so that there’s a theory that Herdier was the first Pokémon to partner with people.
pokemon.herdier.name: Herdier
pokemon.hippopotas.flavor: Though large and languid, Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.
pokemon.hippopotas.name: Hippopotas
pokemon.hippowdon.flavor: Short-tempered and easily moved to violence. It whips up whirlwinds of sand to crush its foes' spirits, then goes in for the attack.
pokemon.hippowdon.name: Hippowdon
pokemon.hitmonchan.flavor: Its punches slice the air. They are launched at such high speed, even a slight graze could cause a burn.
pokemon.hitmonchan.name: Hitmonchan
pokemon.hitmonlee.flavor: This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.
pokemon.hitmonlee.name: Hitmonlee
pokemon.hitmontop.flavor: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.
pokemon.hitmontop.name: Hitmontop
pokemon.honchkrow.flavor: One cry from this Pokémon, and a murder of Murkrow come flying. At such times, one would think the curtain of night had fallen, plunging the world into jet-black darkness.
pokemon.honchkrow.name: Honchkrow
pokemon.honedge.flavor: Honedge’s soul once belonged to a person who was killed a long time ago by the sword that makes up Honedge’s body.
pokemon.honedge.name: Honedge
pokemon.hooh.flavor: Ho-Oh’s feathers glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light. These feathers are said to bring happiness to the bearers. This Pokémon is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.
pokemon.hooh.name: Ho-Oh
pokemon.hoopa.flavor: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.
pokemon.hoopa.name: Hoopa
pokemon.hoopaunbound.name: Hoopa Unbound
pokemon.hoothoot.flavor: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.
pokemon.hoothoot.name: Hoothoot
pokemon.hoppip.flavor: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, Hoppip links its leaves with other Hoppip to prepare against being blown away.
pokemon.hoppip.name: Hoppip
pokemon.horsea.flavor: Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits out pitch-black ink and escapes.
pokemon.horsea.name: Horsea
pokemon.houndoom.flavor: They spew flames mixed with poison to finish off their opponents. They divvy up their prey evenly among the members of their pack.
pokemon.houndoom.name: Houndoom
pokemon.houndoommega.name: Mega Houndoom
pokemon.houndour.flavor: It cooperates with others skillfully. When it becomes your partner, it’s very loyal to you as its Trainer and will obey your orders.
pokemon.houndour.name: Houndour
pokemon.houndstone.flavor: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.
pokemon.houndstone.name: Houndstone
pokemon.huntail.flavor: It’s not the strongest swimmer. It wags its tail to lure in its prey and then gulps them down as soon as they get close.
pokemon.huntail.name: Huntail
pokemon.hydrapple.flavor: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander.
pokemon.hydrapple.name: Hydrapple
pokemon.hydreigon.flavor: There are a slew of stories about villages that were destroyed by Hydreigon. It bites anything that moves.
pokemon.hydreigon.name: Hydreigon
pokemon.hypno.flavor: Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.
pokemon.hypno.name: Hypno
pokemon.igglybuff.flavor: Igglybuff loves to sing. Its marshmallow-like body gives off a faint sweet smell.
pokemon.igglybuff.name: Igglybuff
pokemon.illumise.flavor: Illumise attracts a swarm of Volbeat using a sweet fragrance. Once the Volbeat have gathered, this Pokémon leads the lit-up swarm in drawing geometric designs on the canvas of the night sky.
pokemon.illumise.name: Illumise
pokemon.impidimp.flavor: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.
pokemon.impidimp.name: Impidimp
pokemon.incineroar.flavor: It excels at violent, no-holds-barred battles. The temperature of the flames that issue from its navel exceeds 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokemon.incineroar.name: Incineroar
pokemon.indeedee.flavor: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.
pokemon.indeedee.name: Indeedee
pokemon.indeedeef.name: Female Indeedee
pokemon.infernape.flavor: A tall, hardy Pokémon with a dazzling appearance. It shrouds itself in flame and battles as if engaged in dance—truly a sight to behold.
pokemon.infernape.name: Infernape
pokemon.inkay.flavor: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.
pokemon.inkay.name: Inkay
pokemon.inteleon.flavor: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.
pokemon.inteleon.name: Inteleon
pokemon.inteleongmax.name: Gigantamax Inteleon
pokemon.ironboulder.flavor: It resembles a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a Terrakion that had been modified by an evil organization.
pokemon.ironboulder.name: Iron Boulder
pokemon.ironbundle.flavor: Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a paranormal magazine article. The robot was said to have been created by an ancient civilization.
pokemon.ironbundle.name: Iron Bundle
pokemon.ironcrown.flavor: It resembles a mysterious object introduced in a paranormal magazine as a cutting-edge weapon shaped like a Cobalion.
pokemon.ironcrown.name: Iron Crown
pokemon.ironhands.flavor: It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively by a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said to be the modified form of a certain athlete.
pokemon.ironhands.name: Iron Hands
pokemon.ironjugulis.flavor: It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a paranormal magazine, described as the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.
pokemon.ironjugulis.name: Iron Jugulis
pokemon.ironleaves.flavor: Many of its physical characteristics match those of a Virizion from the future that was covered in a paranormal magazine.
pokemon.ironleaves.name: Iron Leaves
pokemon.ironmoth.flavor: This Pokémon resembles an unknown object described in a paranormal magazine as a UFO sent to observe humanity.
pokemon.ironmoth.name: Iron Moth
pokemon.ironthorns.flavor: It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one billion years into the future.
pokemon.ironthorns.name: Iron Thorns
pokemon.irontreads.flavor: This Pokémon closely resembles a scientific weapon that a paranormal magazine claimed was sent to this planet by aliens.
pokemon.irontreads.name: Iron Treads
pokemon.ironvaliant.flavor: It has some similarities to a mad scientist’s invention covered in a paranormal magazine.
pokemon.ironvaliant.name: Iron Valiant
pokemon.ivysaur.flavor: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.
pokemon.ivysaur.name: Ivysaur
pokemon.jangmoo.flavor: They learn to fight by smashing their head scales together. The dueling strengthens both their skills and their spirits.
pokemon.jangmoo.name: Jangmo-o
pokemon.jellicent.flavor: Most of this Pokémon’s body composition is identical to sea water. It makes sunken ships its lair.
pokemon.jellicent.name: Jellicent
pokemon.jigglypuff.flavor: Jigglypuff has top-notch lung capacity, even by comparison to other Pokémon. It won’t stop singing its lullabies until its foes fall asleep.
pokemon.jigglypuff.name: Jigglypuff
pokemon.jirachi.flavor: Once every 1,000 years, the singing of a pure voice will rouse this Pokémon from its near-perpetual slumber. It wakes for only seven days.
pokemon.jirachi.name: Jirachi
pokemon.jolteon.flavor: Bristles its fur into sharp, needlelike points when enraged. One can hear electricity crackle in its breath when it exhales.
pokemon.jolteon.name: Jolteon
pokemon.joltik.flavor: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon. It’s soaking up static electricity because it can’t produce a charge on its own.
pokemon.joltik.name: Joltik
pokemon.jumpluff.flavor: Jumpluff rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The Pokémon descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.
pokemon.jumpluff.name: Jumpluff
pokemon.jynx.flavor: In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.
pokemon.jynx.name: Jynx
pokemon.kabuto.flavor: This species is almost entirely extinct. Kabuto molt every three days, making their shells harder and harder.
pokemon.kabuto.name: Kabuto
pokemon.kabutops.flavor: Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks out the fluids. The discarded body parts become food for other Pokémon.
pokemon.kabutops.name: Kabutops
pokemon.kadabra.flavor: There are rumors that a child with mystical powers became a Kadabra; however, this remains unverified. I suspect that the spoon Kadabra holds enhances its brain waves.
pokemon.kadabra.name: Kadabra
pokemon.kakuna.flavor: Able to move only slightly. When endangered, it may stick out its stinger and poison its enemy.
pokemon.kakuna.name: Kakuna
pokemon.kangaskhan.flavor: Although it’s carrying its baby in a pouch on its belly, Kangaskhan is swift on its feet. It intimidates its opponents with quick jabs.
pokemon.kangaskhan.name: Kangaskhan
pokemon.kangaskhanmega.name: Mega Kangaskhan
pokemon.karrablast.flavor: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.
pokemon.karrablast.name: Karrablast
pokemon.kartana.flavor: This Ultra Beast’s body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.
pokemon.kartana.name: Kartana
pokemon.kecleon.flavor: It changes its hue to blend into its surroundings. If no one takes notice of it for too long, it will pout and never reveal itself.
pokemon.kecleon.name: Kecleon
pokemon.keldeo.flavor: Cobalion, Terrakion, and Virizion taught this Pokémon how to fight. It dashes across the world, seeking more opportunities to further its training.
pokemon.keldeo.name: Keldeo
pokemon.keldeoresolute.name: Resolute Keldeo
pokemon.kilowattrel.flavor: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.
pokemon.kilowattrel.name: Kilowattrel
pokemon.kingambit.flavor: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.
pokemon.kingambit.name: Kingambit
pokemon.kingdra.flavor: With the arrival of a storm at sea, this Pokémon will show itself on the surface. When a Kingdra and a Dragonite meet, a fierce battle ensues.
pokemon.kingdra.name: Kingdra
pokemon.kingler.flavor: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.
pokemon.kingler.name: Kingler
pokemon.kinglergmax.name: Gigantamax Kingler
pokemon.kirlia.flavor: It resembles a maiden in appearance, but it wields strange powers to project visions of paradise. I suspect the crimson ornaments on its head are the key to its abilities.
pokemon.kirlia.name: Kirlia
pokemon.klang.flavor: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon’s rotation speed increases sharply.
pokemon.klang.name: Klang
pokemon.klawf.flavor: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can’t remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.
pokemon.klawf.name: Klawf
pokemon.kleavor.flavor: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.
pokemon.kleavor.name: Kleavor
pokemon.klefki.flavor: This Pokémon is constantly collecting keys. Entrust a Klefki with important keys, and the Pokémon will protect them no matter what.
pokemon.klefki.name: Klefki
pokemon.klink.flavor: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.
pokemon.klink.name: Klink
pokemon.klinklang.flavor: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.
pokemon.klinklang.name: Klinklang
pokemon.koffing.flavor: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.
pokemon.koffing.name: Koffing
pokemon.komala.flavor: It stays asleep from the moment it’s born. When it falls into a deep sleep, it stops moving altogether.
pokemon.komala.name: Komala
pokemon.kommoo.flavor: It clatters its tail scales to unnerve opponents. This Pokémon will battle only those who stand steadfast in the face of this display.
pokemon.kommoo.name: Kommo-o
pokemon.kommoototem.name: Totem Kommo-o
pokemon.koraidon.flavor: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.
pokemon.koraidon.name: Koraidon
pokemon.krabby.flavor: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.
pokemon.krabby.name: Krabby
pokemon.kricketot.flavor: When the trees take on new hues, more of these Pokémon appear. The tone they create by striking their antennae together resembles that of the marimba, an instrument of foreign lands.
pokemon.kricketot.name: Kricketot
pokemon.kricketune.flavor: It uses its cutlass-like arms to produce sound, the melody of which varies from individual to individual. It is a worthwhile endeavor to seek out one's favorite tunes.
pokemon.kricketune.name: Kricketune
pokemon.krokorok.flavor: Krokorok has specialized eyes that enable it to see in the dark. This ability lets Krokorok hunt in the dead of night without getting lost.
pokemon.krokorok.name: Krokorok
pokemon.krookodile.flavor: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sands. Krookodile’s mighty jaws can bite through heavy plates of iron with almost no effort at all.
pokemon.krookodile.name: Krookodile
pokemon.kubfu.flavor: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.
pokemon.kubfu.name: Kubfu
pokemon.kyogre.flavor: Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can summon storms that cause the sea levels to rise.
pokemon.kyogre.name: Kyogre
pokemon.kyogreprimal.name: Primal Kyogre
pokemon.kyurem.flavor: Dwelling within it is a power even greater than that of Reshiram or Zekrom, but the extreme cold keeps that power bound.
pokemon.kyurem.name: Kyurem
pokemon.kyuremblack.name: Black Kyurem
pokemon.kyuremwhite.name: White Kyurem
pokemon.lairon.flavor: Lairon live in mountains brimming with spring water and iron ore, so these Pokémon often came into conflict with humans in the past.
pokemon.lairon.name: Lairon
pokemon.lampent.flavor: This Pokémon appears just before someone passes away, so it’s feared as an emissary of death.
pokemon.lampent.name: Lampent
pokemon.landorus.flavor: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.
pokemon.landorus.name: Landorus
pokemon.landorustherian.name: Therian Landorus
pokemon.lanturn.flavor: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea’s surface from a depth of over three miles.
pokemon.lanturn.name: Lanturn
pokemon.lapras.flavor: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.
pokemon.lapras.name: Lapras
pokemon.laprasgmax.name: Gigantamax Lapras
pokemon.larvesta.flavor: The people of ancient times believed that Larvesta fell from the sun.
pokemon.larvesta.name: Larvesta
pokemon.larvitar.flavor: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.
pokemon.larvitar.name: Larvitar
pokemon.latias.flavor: Latias is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this Pokémon ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.
pokemon.latias.name: Latias
pokemon.latiasmega.name: Mega Latias
pokemon.latios.flavor: Latios has the ability to make others see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This Pokémon is intelligent and understands human speech.
pokemon.latios.name: Latios
pokemon.latiosmega.name: Mega Latios
pokemon.leafeon.flavor: Cells similar to those of plants have been found in its fur. Its hard tail can fell a large tree with one stroke, and the tail's sharpness exceeds even that of a sword crafted by a master.
pokemon.leafeon.name: Leafeon
pokemon.leavanny.flavor: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.
pokemon.leavanny.name: Leavanny
pokemon.lechonk.flavor: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn’t use it for anything other than foraging.
pokemon.lechonk.name: Lechonk
pokemon.ledian.flavor: It’s said that the patterns on its back are related to the stars in the night sky, but the details of that relationship remain unclear.
pokemon.ledian.name: Ledian
pokemon.ledyba.flavor: This Pokémon is very sensitive to cold. In the warmth of Alola, it appears quite lively.
pokemon.ledyba.name: Ledyba
pokemon.lickilicky.flavor: Its tongue can extend and contract freely, and it is capable of reaching lengths over 10 times Lickilicky's height. Beware of the saliva, as it contains corrosive elements.
pokemon.lickilicky.name: Lickilicky
pokemon.lickitung.flavor: Wields its long tongue deftly, as though it were an arm. The Pokémon's viscous saliva, once it has been collected and boiled down, yields a strong and highly useful adhesive.
pokemon.lickitung.name: Lickitung
pokemon.liepard.flavor: Don’t be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.
pokemon.liepard.name: Liepard
pokemon.lileep.flavor: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. Lileep once lived in warm seas that existed approximately 100,000,000 years ago.
pokemon.lileep.name: Lileep
pokemon.lilligant.flavor: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.
pokemon.lilligant.name: Lilligant
pokemon.lilliganthisui.name: Hisuian Lilligant
pokemon.lillipup.flavor: This Pokémon is courageous but also cautious. It uses the soft fur covering its face to collect information about its surroundings.
pokemon.lillipup.name: Lillipup
pokemon.linoone.flavor: Its fur is strong and supple. Shaving brushes made with shed Linoone hairs are highly prized.
pokemon.linoone.name: Linoone
pokemon.linoonegalar.name: Galarian Linoone
pokemon.litleo.flavor: When they’re young, they live with a pride. Once they’re able to hunt prey on their own, they’re kicked out and have to make their own way.
pokemon.litleo.name: Litleo
pokemon.litten.flavor: It spends even the smallest amount of downtime grooming its fur with its tongue. Loose fur gathers in its stomach and serves as fuel for fiery moves.
pokemon.litten.name: Litten
pokemon.litwick.flavor: The flame on its head keeps its body slightly warm. This Pokémon takes lost children by the hand to guide them to the spirit world.
pokemon.litwick.name: Litwick
pokemon.lokix.flavor: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.
pokemon.lokix.name: Lokix
pokemon.lombre.flavor: It is nocturnal and becomes active at nightfall. It feeds on aquatic mosses that grow in the riverbed.
pokemon.lombre.name: Lombre
pokemon.lopunny.flavor: Its fur is warm and yet remarkably light. This Pokémon kicks as though it were a master of karate, driving back its opponents with ease.
pokemon.lopunny.name: Lopunny
pokemon.lopunnymega.name: Mega Lopunny
pokemon.lotad.flavor: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.
pokemon.lotad.name: Lotad
pokemon.loudred.flavor: Loudred’s ears serve as speakers, and they can put out sound waves powerful enough to blow away a house.
pokemon.loudred.name: Loudred
pokemon.lucario.flavor: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name ”aura” to this power.
pokemon.lucario.name: Lucario
pokemon.lucariomega.name: Mega Lucario
pokemon.lucariomegaz.name: Mega Lucario Z
pokemon.ludicolo.flavor: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo’s cells, making it more powerful.
pokemon.ludicolo.name: Ludicolo
pokemon.lugia.flavor: Lugia’s wings pack devastating power—a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart regular houses. As a result, this Pokémon chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.
pokemon.lugia.name: Lugia
pokemon.lumineon.flavor: Uses its gleaming fins to hunt its prey. The view of Lumineon schooling near the surface of the sea at night is breathtaking— it's as though there were shining stars right there.
pokemon.lumineon.name: Lumineon
pokemon.lunala.flavor: Known as the Beast That Calls the Moon, this Pokémon lives by taking in any and all light and converting it into its own energy.
pokemon.lunala.name: Lunala
pokemon.lunatone.flavor: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It’s active on the night of a full moon.
pokemon.lunatone.name: Lunatone
pokemon.lurantis.flavor: This Pokémon resembles a beautiful flower. A properly raised Lurantis will have gorgeous, brilliant colors.
pokemon.lurantis.name: Lurantis
pokemon.lurantistotem.name: Totem Lurantis
pokemon.luvdisc.flavor: There was an era when it was overfished due to the rumor that having one of its heart-shaped scales would enable you to find a sweetheart.
pokemon.luvdisc.name: Luvdisc
pokemon.luxio.flavor: Proudly uses its electrified claws as weapons. It seems to be a gracious Pokémon, evenly sharing the spoils of the hunt with others of its kind.
pokemon.luxio.name: Luxio
pokemon.luxray.flavor: They form packs, each having one male as leader. Legends say that when Luxray's two eyes shimmer with gold, the Pokémon can see through anything.
pokemon.luxray.name: Luxray
pokemon.lycanroc.flavor: This Lycanroc is calm and cautious. The rocks jutting from its mane are razor sharp.
pokemon.lycanroc.name: Lycanroc
pokemon.lycanrocdusk.name: Dusk Lycanroc
pokemon.lycanrocmidnight.name: Midnight Lycanroc
pokemon.mabosstiff.flavor: This Pokémon can store energy in its large dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all at once to blow away enemies.
pokemon.mabosstiff.name: Mabosstiff
pokemon.machamp.flavor: In close combat, its four arms afford it offensive and defensive supremacy. In but a blink, this valiant Pokémon can overwhelm its foes with more than 1,000 blows from its fists.
pokemon.machamp.name: Machamp
pokemon.machampgmax.name: Gigantamax Machamp
pokemon.machoke.flavor: A sturdy creature boasting a robust physique and boundless stamina. Loves training above all else and voluntarily assists with tasks such as construction and clearing land.
pokemon.machoke.name: Machoke
pokemon.machop.flavor: Though as small as a child, it has strength enough to easily throw a well-built adult. Striving to become ever stronger, Machop trains by carrying a Graveler on its shoulders.
pokemon.machop.name: Machop
pokemon.magby.flavor: This Pokémon lives in volcanic areas. With each breath, sparks spurt from its mouth and nose. When Magby is in good health, its flames gain a yellow tint.
pokemon.magby.name: Magby
pokemon.magcargo.flavor: Magcargo’s shell is actually its skin that hardened as a result of cooling. Its shell is very brittle and fragile—just touching it causes it to crumble apart. This Pokémon returns to its original size by dipping itself in magma.
pokemon.magcargo.name: Magcargo
pokemon.magearna.flavor: It synchronizes its consciousness with others to understand their feelings. This faculty makes it useful for taking care of people.
pokemon.magearna.name: Magearna
pokemon.magearnamega.name: Mega Magearna
pokemon.magearnaoriginal.name: Original Magearna
pokemon.magearnaoriginalmega.name: Mega Original Magearna
pokemon.magikarp.flavor: A feeble, pitiful imbecile of a Pokémon that is nonetheless very hardy. Unperturbed by turbid water, it can be found living in all sorts of places.
pokemon.magikarp.name: Magikarp
pokemon.magmar.flavor: Legend has it that this Pokémon was born from the crater of a volcano. When wounded, it bathes in lava to heal its body, much as one would soak in a hot spring.
pokemon.magmar.name: Magmar
pokemon.magmortar.flavor: Use of a strange item caused this Pokémon to evolve. Fireballs launched from the ends of its tubelike arms are hot enough to melt an iron pot in an instant.
pokemon.magmortar.name: Magmortar
pokemon.magnemite.flavor: A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere. I suspect this creature levitates due to the magnetism it emits from its arms, which resemble horseshoe-shaped magnets.
pokemon.magnemite.name: Magnemite
pokemon.magneton.flavor: Three Magnemite gathered to evolve into this Pokémon. The source of much vexation on my part, as its powerful magnetism destroys my research equipment.
pokemon.magneton.name: Magneton
pokemon.magnezone.flavor: I theorize that a special magnetic field influenced this Pokémon, changing its molecular structure and causing it to evolve. It emits strange radio waves toward space from its antenna.
pokemon.magnezone.name: Magnezone
pokemon.makuhita.flavor: It practices its slaps by repeatedly slapping tree trunks. It has been known to slap an Exeggutor and get flung away.
pokemon.makuhita.name: Makuhita
pokemon.malamar.flavor: Gazing at its luminescent spots will quickly induce a hypnotic state, putting the observer under Malamar’s control.
pokemon.malamar.name: Malamar
pokemon.malamarmega.name: Mega Malamar
pokemon.mamoswine.flavor: This species reached its zenith during the period known as the ice age. I suspect that Hisui's frigid climate is in harmony with Mamoswine's constitution, thus awakening hidden potential.
pokemon.mamoswine.name: Mamoswine
pokemon.manaphy.flavor: Rumored to migrate across the oceans and visit Hisui's coastal waters only rarely. Although Manaphy resembles Phione, it is also quite different. The relation between the two is unclear.
pokemon.manaphy.name: Manaphy
pokemon.mandibuzz.flavor: Although it’s a bit of a ruffian, this Pokémon will take lost Vullaby under its wing and care for them till they’re ready to leave the nest.
pokemon.mandibuzz.name: Mandibuzz
pokemon.manectric.flavor: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.
pokemon.manectric.name: Manectric
pokemon.manectricmega.name: Mega Manectric
pokemon.mankey.flavor: An agile Pokémon that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.
pokemon.mankey.name: Mankey
pokemon.mantine.flavor: This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.
pokemon.mantine.name: Mantine
pokemon.mantyke.flavor: Though ball-like in shape, this Pokémon is a proficient swimmer. I have discovered that if a Mantyke spends much time with schools of Remoraid, it will eventually achieve evolution.
pokemon.mantyke.name: Mantyke
pokemon.maractus.flavor: With noises that could be mistaken for the rattles of maracas, it creates an upbeat rhythm, startling bird Pokémon and making them fly off in a hurry.
pokemon.maractus.name: Maractus
pokemon.mareanie.flavor: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it’s impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.
pokemon.mareanie.name: Mareanie
pokemon.mareep.flavor: Clothing made from Mareep’s fleece is easily charged with static electricity, so a special process is used on it.
pokemon.mareep.name: Mareep
pokemon.marill.flavor: This Pokémon uses its round tail as a float. The ball of Marill’s tail is filled with nutrients that have been turned into an oil.
pokemon.marill.name: Marill
pokemon.marowak.flavor: This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.
pokemon.marowak.name: Marowak
pokemon.marowakalola.name: Alolan Marowak
pokemon.marowaktotem.name: Totem Alolan Marowak
pokemon.marshadow.flavor: By slipping into the shadow of a martial arts master and copying their movements, this Pokémon learned the ultimate techniques.
pokemon.marshadow.name: Marshadow
pokemon.marshtomp.flavor: The surface of Marshtomp’s body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This Pokémon plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.
pokemon.marshtomp.name: Marshtomp
pokemon.maschiff.flavor: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff’s face.
pokemon.maschiff.name: Maschiff
pokemon.masquerain.flavor: Masquerain intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns of its eyespots. If that doesn’t work, it deftly makes its escape on its set of four wings.
pokemon.masquerain.name: Masquerain
pokemon.maushold.name: Maushold (Family of Three)
pokemon.mausholdfour.flavor: The two little ones just appeared one day. The group might be a family of related Pokémon, but nobody knows for sure.
pokemon.mausholdfour.name: Maushold
pokemon.mawile.flavor: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.
pokemon.mawile.name: Mawile
pokemon.mawilemega.name: Mega Mawile
pokemon.medicham.flavor: It is said that through meditation, Medicham heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This Pokémon hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.
pokemon.medicham.name: Medicham
pokemon.medichammega.name: Mega Medicham
pokemon.meditite.flavor: Meditite undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this Pokémon always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.
pokemon.meditite.name: Meditite
pokemon.meganium.flavor: The fragrance of Meganium’s flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, this Pokémon gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe’s fighting spirit.
pokemon.meganium.name: Meganium
pokemon.meganiummega.name: Mega Meganium
pokemon.melmetal.flavor: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.
pokemon.melmetal.name: Melmetal
pokemon.melmetalgmax.name: Gigantamax Melmetal
pokemon.meloetta.flavor: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.
pokemon.meloetta.name: Meloetta
pokemon.meloettapirouette.name: Pirouette Meloetta
pokemon.meltan.flavor: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.
pokemon.meltan.name: Meltan
pokemon.meowscarada.flavor: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.
pokemon.meowscarada.name: Meowscarada
pokemon.meowstic.flavor: Revealing the eyelike patterns on the insides of its ears will unleash its psychic powers. It normally keeps the patterns hidden, however.
pokemon.meowstic.name: Meowstic
pokemon.meowsticf.name: Female Meowstic
pokemon.meowsticfmega.name: Mega Meowstic
pokemon.meowsticmmega.name: Mega Meowstic
pokemon.meowth.flavor: It loves to collect shiny things. If it’s in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.
pokemon.meowth.name: Meowth
pokemon.meowthalola.name: Alolan Meowth
pokemon.meowthgalar.name: Galarian Meowth
pokemon.meowthgmax.name: Gigantamax Meowth
pokemon.mesprit.flavor: Known as the Being of Emotion. In legend, this Pokémon was feared, as any who showed disrespect would have their emotions thrown into disarray.
pokemon.mesprit.name: Mesprit
pokemon.metagross.flavor: Because the magnetic powers of these Pokémon get stronger in freezing temperatures, Metagross living on snowy mountains are full of energy.
pokemon.metagross.name: Metagross
pokemon.metagrossmega.name: Mega Metagross
pokemon.metang.flavor: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.
pokemon.metang.name: Metang
pokemon.metapod.flavor: It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.
pokemon.metapod.name: Metapod
pokemon.mew.flavor: When viewed through a microscope, this Pokémon’s short, fine, delicate hair can be seen.
pokemon.mew.name: Mew
pokemon.mewtwo.flavor: Its DNA is almost the same as Mew’s. However, its size and disposition are vastly different.
pokemon.mewtwo.name: Mewtwo
pokemon.mewtwomegax.name: Mega Mewtwo X
pokemon.mewtwomegay.name: Mega Mewtwo Y
pokemon.mienfoo.flavor: In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo can chop with its arms more than 100 times.
pokemon.mienfoo.name: Mienfoo
pokemon.mienshao.flavor: When Mienshao comes across a truly challenging opponent, it will lighten itself by biting off the fur on its arms.
pokemon.mienshao.name: Mienshao
pokemon.mightyena.flavor: Mightyena gives obvious signals when it is preparing to attack. It starts to growl deeply and then flattens its body. This Pokémon will bite savagely with its sharply pointed fangs.
pokemon.mightyena.name: Mightyena
pokemon.milcery.flavor: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.
pokemon.milcery.name: Milcery
pokemon.milotic.flavor: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.
pokemon.milotic.name: Milotic
pokemon.miltank.flavor: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it’s been supporting the lives of people and other Pokémon since ancient times.
pokemon.miltank.name: Miltank
pokemon.mimejr.flavor: Known to turn up in bustling marketplaces now and again. It mimics people much as a child would, then watches how they react, eyes sparkling.
pokemon.mimejr.name: Mime Jr.
pokemon.mimikyu.flavor: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.
pokemon.mimikyu.name: Mimikyu
pokemon.mimikyubusted.name: Busted Mimikyu
pokemon.mimikyubustedtotem.name: Totem Busted Mimikyu
pokemon.mimikyutotem.name: Totem Disguised Mimikyu
pokemon.minccino.flavor: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.
pokemon.minccino.name: Minccino
pokemon.minior.name: Red Core Minior
pokemon.miniorblue.name: Blue Core Minior
pokemon.miniorgreen.name: Green Core Minior
pokemon.miniorindigo.name: Indigo Core Minior
pokemon.miniormeteor.flavor: It lives in the ozone layer, where it becomes food for stronger Pokémon. When it tries to run away, it falls to the ground.
pokemon.miniormeteor.name: Minior
pokemon.miniormeteorblue.name: Blue Meteor Minior
pokemon.miniormeteorgreen.name: Green Meteor Minior
pokemon.miniormeteorindigo.name: Indigo Meteor Minior
pokemon.miniormeteororange.name: Orange Meteor Minior
pokemon.miniormeteorviolet.name: Violet Meteor Minior
pokemon.miniormeteoryellow.name: Yellow Meteor Minior
pokemon.miniororange.name: Orange Core Minior
pokemon.miniorviolet.name: Violet Core Minior
pokemon.minioryellow.name: Yellow Core Minior
pokemon.minun.flavor: Minun is more concerned about cheering on its partners than its own safety. It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of sparks to cheer on its teammates.
pokemon.minun.name: Minun
pokemon.miraidon.flavor: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.
pokemon.miraidon.name: Miraidon
pokemon.misdreavus.flavor: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.
pokemon.misdreavus.name: Misdreavus
pokemon.mismagius.flavor: The incantations Mismagius chants can ward against misfortune, so a custom exists of inviting it into one's home. Incur the Pokémon's displeasure, however, and disaster will surely ensue.
pokemon.mismagius.name: Mismagius
pokemon.moltres.flavor: It’s one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.
pokemon.moltres.name: Moltres
pokemon.moltresgalar.name: Galarian Moltres
pokemon.monferno.flavor: The deeper the blue on its face, the more powerful it will grow to become. It leaps about every which way and lands powerful blows against its opponents with the flame on its tail.
pokemon.monferno.name: Monferno
pokemon.morelull.flavor: Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull’s head. The caps regrow overnight.
pokemon.morelull.name: Morelull
pokemon.morgrem.flavor: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it’s trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.
pokemon.morgrem.name: Morgrem
pokemon.morpeko.flavor: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It’s also generating electricity.
pokemon.morpeko.name: Morpeko
pokemon.morpekohangry.name: Hangry Morpeko
pokemon.mothim.flavor: Scatters steel-colored scales as it flaps its wings. Despite being observed feeding primarily on the nectar of flowers, Mothim is not often seen around flower gardens.
pokemon.mothim.name: Mothim
pokemon.mrmime.flavor: The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.
pokemon.mrmime.name: Mr. Mime
pokemon.mrmimegalar.name: Galarian Mr. Mime
pokemon.mrrime.flavor: It’s highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.
pokemon.mrrime.name: Mr. Rime
pokemon.mudbray.flavor: Loads weighing up to 50 times as much as its own body weight pose no issue for this Pokémon. It’s skilled at making use of mud.
pokemon.mudbray.name: Mudbray
pokemon.mudkip.flavor: The fin on Mudkip’s head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this Pokémon can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.
pokemon.mudkip.name: Mudkip
pokemon.mudsdale.flavor: Mud that hardens around a Mudsdale’s legs sets harder than stone. It’s so hard that it allows this Pokémon to scrap a truck with a single kick.
pokemon.mudsdale.name: Mudsdale
pokemon.muk.flavor: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.
pokemon.muk.name: Muk
pokemon.mukalola.name: Alolan Muk
pokemon.munchlax.flavor: Its robust stomach allows it to nonchalantly devour even rotted matter. It pays frequent visits to villages, seeking out food scraps intended for compost.
pokemon.munchlax.name: Munchlax
pokemon.munkidori.flavor: The chain is made from toxins that enhance capabilities. It stimulated Munkidori's brain and caused the Pokémon's psychic powers to bloom.
pokemon.munkidori.name: Munkidori
pokemon.munna.flavor: Late at night, it appears beside people’s pillows. As it feeds on dreams, the patterns on its body give off a faint glow.
pokemon.munna.name: Munna
pokemon.murkrow.flavor: Widely shunned as a bearer of ill fortune. Upon crossing paths with this creature, I've been told one must chant ”Workrum, Workrum—bad luck, don't come” as a protective incantation.
pokemon.murkrow.name: Murkrow
pokemon.musharna.flavor: When dark mists emanate from its body, don’t get too near. If you do, your nightmares will become reality.
pokemon.musharna.name: Musharna
pokemon.nacli.flavor: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.
pokemon.nacli.name: Nacli
pokemon.naclstack.flavor: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey’s body.
pokemon.naclstack.name: Naclstack
pokemon.naganadel.flavor: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.
pokemon.naganadel.name: Naganadel
pokemon.natu.flavor: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.
pokemon.natu.name: Natu
pokemon.necrozma.flavor: It survives by absorbing light. After a long time spent slumbering underground, impurities accumulated within it, causing its body to darken.
pokemon.necrozma.name: Necrozma
pokemon.necrozmadawnwings.name: Dawn Necrozma
pokemon.necrozmaduskmane.name: Dusk Necrozma
pokemon.necrozmaultra.name: Ultra Necrozma
pokemon.nickit.flavor: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.
pokemon.nickit.name: Nickit
pokemon.nidoking.flavor: When it goes on a rampage, it’s impossible to control. But in the presence of a Nidoqueen it’s lived with for a long time, Nidoking calms down.
pokemon.nidoking.name: Nidoking
pokemon.nidoqueen.flavor: Nidoqueen is better at defense than offense. With scales like armor, this Pokémon will shield its children from any kind of attack.
pokemon.nidoqueen.name: Nidoqueen
pokemon.nidoranf.flavor: Females are more sensitive to smells than males. While foraging, they’ll use their whiskers to check wind direction and stay downwind of predators.
pokemon.nidoranf.name: Nidoran♀
pokemon.nidoranm.flavor: The horn on a male Nidoran’s forehead contains a powerful poison. This is a very cautious Pokémon, always straining its large ears.
pokemon.nidoranm.name: Nidoran♂
pokemon.nidorina.flavor: The horn on its head has atrophied. It’s thought that this happens so Nidorina’s children won’t get poked while their mother is feeding them.
pokemon.nidorina.name: Nidorina
pokemon.nidorino.flavor: With a horn that’s harder than diamond, this Pokémon goes around shattering boulders as it searches for a moon stone.
pokemon.nidorino.name: Nidorino
pokemon.nihilego.flavor: A life-form from another world, it was dubbed a UB and is thought to produce a strong neurotoxin.
pokemon.nihilego.name: Nihilego
pokemon.nincada.flavor: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.
pokemon.nincada.name: Nincada
pokemon.ninetales.flavor: The coat of gleaming golden fur is quite magnificent. This species is said to store sacred power in its nine long tails and to live for a millennium.
pokemon.ninetales.name: Ninetales
pokemon.ninetalesalola.name: Alolan Ninetales
pokemon.ninjask.flavor: Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too long. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.
pokemon.ninjask.name: Ninjask
pokemon.noctowl.flavor: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.
pokemon.noctowl.name: Noctowl
pokemon.noibat.flavor: After nightfall, they emerge from the caves they nest in during the day. Using their ultrasonic waves, they go on the hunt for ripened fruit.
pokemon.noibat.name: Noibat
pokemon.noivern.flavor: Aggressive and cruel, this Pokémon will ruthlessly torment enemies that are helpless in the dark.
pokemon.noivern.name: Noivern
pokemon.nosepass.flavor: Once the people of Hisui discovered that its red nose always points north, they grew to rely on it greatly when traveling afar. The nose seems to work in a similar way to ancient compasses.
pokemon.nosepass.name: Nosepass
pokemon.numel.flavor: Numel is extremely dull witted—it doesn’t notice being hit. However, it can’t stand hunger for even a second. This Pokémon’s body is a seething cauldron of boiling magma.
pokemon.numel.name: Numel
pokemon.nuzleaf.flavor: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.
pokemon.nuzleaf.name: Nuzleaf
pokemon.nymble.flavor: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it’s in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.
pokemon.nymble.name: Nymble
pokemon.obstagoon.flavor: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.
pokemon.obstagoon.name: Obstagoon
pokemon.octillery.flavor: While Octillery still shoots water from its mouth, the drastic anatomical difference between it and Remoraid meant that for a long time, no one believed the former evolved from the latter.
pokemon.octillery.name: Octillery
pokemon.oddish.flavor: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.
pokemon.oddish.name: Oddish
pokemon.ogerpon.flavor: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.
pokemon.ogerpon.name: Ogerpon
pokemon.ogerponcornerstone.name: Cornerstone Mask Ogerpon
pokemon.ogerponhearthflame.name: Hearthflame Mask Ogerpon
pokemon.ogerponwellspring.name: Wellspring Mask Ogerpon
pokemon.oinkologne.flavor: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.
pokemon.oinkologne.name: Oinkologne
pokemon.oinkolognef.name: Female Oinkologne
pokemon.okidogi.flavor: After all its muscles were stimulated by the toxic chain around its neck, Okidogi transformed and gained a powerful physique.
pokemon.okidogi.name: Okidogi
pokemon.omanyte.flavor: Because some Omanyte manage to escape after being restored or are released into the wild by people, this species is becoming a problem.
pokemon.omanyte.name: Omanyte
pokemon.omastar.flavor: Weighed down by a large and heavy shell, Omastar couldn’t move very fast. Some say it went extinct because it was unable to catch food.
pokemon.omastar.name: Omastar
pokemon.onix.flavor: This chain of immense stones resembles a giant serpent. Tremors shake the earth above as it burrows deep beneath the ground, feeding on boulders as it goes.
pokemon.onix.name: Onix
pokemon.oranguru.flavor: With waves of its fan—made from leaves and its own fur—Oranguru skillfully gives instructions to other Pokémon.
pokemon.oranguru.name: Oranguru
pokemon.orbeetle.flavor: It’s famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.
pokemon.orbeetle.name: Orbeetle
pokemon.orbeetlegmax.name: Gigantamax Orbeetle
pokemon.oricorio.flavor: It wins the hearts of its enemies with its passionate dancing and then uses the opening it creates to burn them up with blazing flames.
pokemon.oricorio.name: Oricorio
pokemon.oricoriopau.name: Pa’u Oricorio
pokemon.oricoriopompom.name: Pom-pom Oricorio
pokemon.oricoriosensu.name: Sensu Oricorio
pokemon.orthworm.flavor: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.
pokemon.orthworm.name: Orthworm
pokemon.oshawott.flavor: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.
pokemon.oshawott.name: Oshawott
pokemon.overqwil.flavor: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.
pokemon.overqwil.name: Overqwil
pokemon.pachirisu.flavor: A species related to the Pikachu line. Though Pachirisu is a calm Pokémon, it still presents a danger should one touch its electrified tail or cheeks.
pokemon.pachirisu.name: Pachirisu
pokemon.palafin.flavor: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.
pokemon.palafin.name: Palafin
pokemon.palafinhero.name: Hero Form Palafin
pokemon.palkia.flavor: This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.
pokemon.palkia.name: Palkia
pokemon.palkiaorigin.name: Origin Palkia
pokemon.palossand.flavor: Palossand is known as the Beach Nightmare. It pulls its prey down into the sand by controlling the sand itself, and then it sucks out their souls.
pokemon.palossand.name: Palossand
pokemon.palpitoad.flavor: It weakens its prey with sound waves intense enough to cause headaches, then entangles them with its sticky tongue.
pokemon.palpitoad.name: Palpitoad
pokemon.pancham.flavor: It chooses a Pangoro as its master and then imitates its master’s actions. This is how it learns to battle and hunt for prey.
pokemon.pancham.name: Pancham
pokemon.pangoro.flavor: This Pokémon is quick to anger, and it has no problem using its prodigious strength to get its way. It lives for duels against Obstagoon.
pokemon.pangoro.name: Pangoro
pokemon.panpour.flavor: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.
pokemon.panpour.name: Panpour
pokemon.pansage.flavor: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.
pokemon.pansage.name: Pansage
pokemon.pansear.flavor: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.
pokemon.pansear.name: Pansear
pokemon.paras.flavor: Sometimes seen at the foot of trees in humid forests. The mushrooms on its back—called tochukaso—are not present on infant specimens and instead emerge as Paras matures.
pokemon.paras.name: Paras
pokemon.parasect.flavor: Mushroom-lacking specimens of this Pokémon lie unmoving in the forest, lending credence to the hypothesis that the large mushroom is in control of Parasect's actions.
pokemon.parasect.name: Parasect
pokemon.passimian.flavor: Displaying amazing teamwork, they follow the orders of their boss as they all help out in the search for their favorite berries.
pokemon.passimian.name: Passimian
pokemon.patrat.flavor: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.
pokemon.patrat.name: Patrat
pokemon.pawmi.flavor: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.
pokemon.pawmi.name: Pawmi
pokemon.pawmo.flavor: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.
pokemon.pawmo.name: Pawmo
pokemon.pawmot.flavor: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.
pokemon.pawmot.name: Pawmot
pokemon.pawniard.flavor: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.
pokemon.pawniard.name: Pawniard
pokemon.pecharunt.flavor: It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires and capabilities. Those who eat the mochi fall under Pecharunt’s control, chained to its will.
pokemon.pecharunt.name: Pecharunt
pokemon.pelipper.flavor: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.
pokemon.pelipper.name: Pelipper
pokemon.perrserker.flavor: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.
pokemon.perrserker.name: Perrserker
pokemon.persian.flavor: Getting this prideful Pokémon to warm up to you takes a lot of effort, and it will claw at you the moment it gets annoyed.
pokemon.persian.name: Persian
pokemon.persianalola.name: Alolan Persian
pokemon.petilil.flavor: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.
pokemon.petilil.name: Petilil
pokemon.phanpy.flavor: For its nest, Phanpy digs a vertical pit in the ground at the edge of a river. It marks the area around its nest with its trunk to let the others know that the area has been claimed.
pokemon.phanpy.name: Phanpy
pokemon.phantump.flavor: After a lost child perished in the forest, their spirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit’s rebirth as this Pokémon.
pokemon.phantump.name: Phantump
pokemon.pheromosa.flavor: A life-form that lives in another world, its body is thin and supple, but it also possesses great power.
pokemon.pheromosa.name: Pheromosa
pokemon.phione.flavor: Can be seen floating offshore during seasons when the seas are warm. Its azure body blends in with the ocean waters—logic suggests this is a defense mechanism against natural predators.
pokemon.phione.name: Phione
pokemon.pichu.flavor: Pichu stores electricity in the sacs on its cheeks but discharges it inadvertently when agitated or excited. Being yet immature, the Pokémon's handling of electricity is rather inept.
pokemon.pichu.name: Pichu
pokemon.pidgeot.flavor: This Pokémon flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.
pokemon.pidgeot.name: Pidgeot
pokemon.pidgeotmega.name: Mega Pidgeot
pokemon.pidgeotto.flavor: This Pokémon is full of vitality. It constantly flies around its large territory in search of prey.
pokemon.pidgeotto.name: Pidgeotto
pokemon.pidgey.flavor: Very docile. If attacked, it will often kick up sand to protect itself rather than fight back.
pokemon.pidgey.name: Pidgey
pokemon.pidove.flavor: Where people go, these Pokémon follow. If you’re scattering food for them, be careful— several hundred of them can gather at once.
pokemon.pidove.name: Pidove
pokemon.pignite.flavor: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.
pokemon.pignite.name: Pignite
pokemon.pikachu.flavor: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.
pokemon.pikachu.name: Pikachu
pokemon.pikachualola.name: Alola Cap Pikachu
pokemon.pikachubelle.name: Pikachu Belle
pokemon.pikachucosplay.name: Cosplay Pikachu
pokemon.pikachugmax.name: Gigantamax Pikachu
pokemon.pikachuhoenn.name: Hoenn Cap Pikachu
pokemon.pikachukalos.name: Kalos Cap Pikachu
pokemon.pikachulibre.name: Pikachu Libre
pokemon.pikachuoriginal.name: Original Cap Pikachu
pokemon.pikachupartner.name: Partner Cap Pikachu
pokemon.pikachuphd.name: Pikachu Ph.D.
pokemon.pikachupopstar.name: Pikachu Pop Star
pokemon.pikachurockstar.name: Pikachu Rock Star
pokemon.pikachusinnoh.name: Sinnoh Cap Pikachu
pokemon.pikachustarter.name: Partner Pikachu
pokemon.pikachuunova.name: Unova Cap Pikachu
pokemon.pikachuworld.name: World Cap Pikachu
pokemon.pikipek.flavor: It pecks at trees with its hard beak. You can get some idea of its mood or condition from the rhythm of its pecking.
pokemon.pikipek.name: Pikipek
pokemon.piloswine.flavor: The long fur of this Pokémon covers its eyes, ears, and even limbs, allowing Piloswine to resist harshly frigid conditions. The Pokémon's white tusks can be used to defeat its enemies.
pokemon.piloswine.name: Piloswine
pokemon.pincurchin.flavor: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.
pokemon.pincurchin.name: Pincurchin
pokemon.pineco.flavor: Motionless, it hangs from trees, waiting for its bug Pokémon prey to come to it. Its favorite in Alola is Cutiefly.
pokemon.pineco.name: Pineco
pokemon.pinsir.flavor: These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.
pokemon.pinsir.name: Pinsir
pokemon.pinsirmega.name: Mega Pinsir
pokemon.piplup.flavor: Prefers cold climes and appears along coasts. It's an adorable little thing—as cute as any child—but it's also prideful, unwilling to accept handouts from people.
pokemon.piplup.name: Piplup
pokemon.plusle.flavor: Plusle always acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this Pokémon shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks to show its joy.
pokemon.plusle.name: Plusle
pokemon.poipole.flavor: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.
pokemon.poipole.name: Poipole
pokemon.politoed.flavor: At nightfall, these Pokémon appear on the shores of lakes. They announce their territorial claims by letting out cries that sound like shouting.
pokemon.politoed.name: Politoed
pokemon.poliwag.flavor: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon’s innards showing through the skin.
pokemon.poliwag.name: Poliwag
pokemon.poliwhirl.flavor: Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness. This trait of Poliwhirl’s has been used in place of lullabies to get children to go to sleep.
pokemon.poliwhirl.name: Poliwhirl
pokemon.poliwrath.flavor: Its body is solid muscle. When swimming through cold seas, Poliwrath uses its impressive arms to smash through drift ice and plow forward.
pokemon.poliwrath.name: Poliwrath
pokemon.poltchageist.flavor: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.
pokemon.poltchageist.name: Poltchageist
pokemon.polteageist.flavor: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.
pokemon.polteageist.name: Polteageist
pokemon.ponyta.flavor: These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.
pokemon.ponyta.name: Ponyta
pokemon.ponytagalar.name: Galarian Ponyta
pokemon.poochyena.flavor: At first sight, Poochyena takes a bite at anything that moves. This Pokémon chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.
pokemon.poochyena.name: Poochyena
pokemon.popplio.flavor: It creates special bouncy balloons to send at its opponents. When the balloons pop, the sheer force of their bursting is what deals damage.
pokemon.popplio.name: Popplio
pokemon.porygon.flavor: It has no discernible heartbeat and does not seem to draw breath, and yet it appears to function without issue. I cannot even begin to explain this utterly bizarre anomaly.
pokemon.porygon.name: Porygon
pokemon.porygon2.flavor: A bizarre item caused this Pokémon to evolve. While it now exhibits many new gestures and expressions, its biology remains inscrutable.
pokemon.porygon2.name: Porygon2
pokemon.porygonz.flavor: A curious item induced this evolution. The Pokémon's offensive capabilities have greatly increased, but the strangeness of its behavior has magnified in equal measure. This worries me.
pokemon.porygonz.name: Porygon-Z
pokemon.primarina.flavor: With its mouth, it makes sonic waves that sound like beautiful singing. It uses the sonic waves to control its water balloons.
pokemon.primarina.name: Primarina
pokemon.primeape.flavor: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.
pokemon.primeape.name: Primeape
pokemon.prinplup.flavor: It swims gracefully through the frigid sea and sings with a voice like the roaring tide. It has powerful, sturdy wings and dignity to match.
pokemon.prinplup.name: Prinplup
pokemon.probopass.flavor: It is able to emit powerful magnetism, allowing it control over the iron sand that forms its luscious mustache. Using this iron sand, Probopass forms hard stones with which it smites its prey.
pokemon.probopass.name: Probopass
pokemon.psyduck.flavor: Suffers perpetual headaches. If the agony grows too great, Psyduck's latent power erupts, contrary to Psyduck's intent. Ergo, I am exploring ways to ease the pain.
pokemon.psyduck.name: Psyduck
pokemon.pumpkaboo.flavor: Spirits that wander this world are placed into Pumpkaboo’s body. They’re then moved on to the afterlife.
pokemon.pumpkaboo.name: Pumpkaboo
pokemon.pumpkaboolarge.name: Large Pumpkaboo
pokemon.pumpkaboosmall.name: Small Pumpkaboo
pokemon.pumpkaboosuper.name: Super Pumpkaboo
pokemon.pupitar.flavor: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.
pokemon.pupitar.name: Pupitar
pokemon.purrloin.flavor: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.
pokemon.purrloin.name: Purrloin
pokemon.purugly.flavor: Though impudent and difficult to tame, Purugly enjoys great popularity due to its fur, the beauty of which surpasses even velveteen.
pokemon.purugly.name: Purugly
pokemon.pyroar.flavor: The males are usually lazy, but when attacked by a strong foe, a male will protect its friends with no regard for its own safety.
pokemon.pyroar.name: Pyroar
pokemon.pyroarmega.name: Mega Pyroar
pokemon.pyukumuku.flavor: It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means to punch them.
pokemon.pyukumuku.name: Pyukumuku
pokemon.quagsire.flavor: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.
pokemon.quagsire.name: Quagsire
pokemon.quaquaval.flavor: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.
pokemon.quaquaval.name: Quaquaval
pokemon.quaxly.flavor: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.
pokemon.quaxly.name: Quaxly
pokemon.quaxwell.flavor: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.
pokemon.quaxwell.name: Quaxwell
pokemon.quilava.flavor: This creature's fur is most mysterious—it is wholly impervious to the burning touch of flame. Should Quilava turn its back to you, take heed! Such a posture indicates a forthcoming attack.
pokemon.quilava.name: Quilava
pokemon.quilladin.flavor: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
pokemon.quilladin.name: Quilladin
pokemon.qwilfish.flavor: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.
pokemon.qwilfish.name: Qwilfish
pokemon.qwilfishhisui.name: Hisuian Qwilfish
pokemon.raboot.flavor: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.
pokemon.raboot.name: Raboot
pokemon.rabsca.flavor: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.
pokemon.rabsca.name: Rabsca
pokemon.ragingbolt.flavor: It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature.
pokemon.ragingbolt.name: Raging Bolt
pokemon.raichu.flavor: It can discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 100,000 volts— a single strike with that amount of power would incapacitate one of the Copperajah of my homeland.
pokemon.raichu.name: Raichu
pokemon.raichualola.name: Alolan Raichu
pokemon.raichumegax.name: Mega Raichu X
pokemon.raichumegay.name: Mega Raichu Y
pokemon.raikou.flavor: Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. The roars of this Pokémon send shock waves shuddering through the air and shake the ground as if lightning bolts had come crashing down.
pokemon.raikou.name: Raikou
pokemon.ralts.flavor: Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.
pokemon.ralts.name: Ralts
pokemon.rampardos.flavor: Very little is known about its biology. Can knock down massive trees by smashing its beautiful, pearl-like crown against them.
pokemon.rampardos.name: Rampardos
pokemon.rapidash.flavor: Fiery mane aglow, Rapidash darts like an arrow across the land. This prodigiously swift creature can traverse the vast region of Hisui in a day and a half.
pokemon.rapidash.name: Rapidash
pokemon.rapidashgalar.name: Galarian Rapidash
pokemon.raticate.flavor: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.
pokemon.raticate.name: Raticate
pokemon.raticatealola.name: Alolan Raticate
pokemon.raticatealolatotem.name: Totem Alolan Raticate
pokemon.rattata.flavor: Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.
pokemon.rattata.name: Rattata
pokemon.rattataalola.name: Alolan Rattata
pokemon.rayquaza.flavor: Rayquaza is said to have lived for hundreds of millions of years. Legends remain of how it put to rest the clash between Kyogre and Groudon.
pokemon.rayquaza.name: Rayquaza
pokemon.rayquazamega.name: Mega Rayquaza
pokemon.regice.flavor: With cold air that can reach temperatures as low as −328 degrees Fahrenheit, Regice instantly freezes any creature that approaches it.
pokemon.regice.name: Regice
pokemon.regidrago.flavor: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago’s arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.
pokemon.regidrago.name: Regidrago
pokemon.regieleki.flavor: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It’s said that removing the rings on Regieleki’s body will unleash the Pokémon’s latent power.
pokemon.regieleki.name: Regieleki
pokemon.regigigas.flavor: According to legend, Regigigas pulled landmasses together and bound them with rope to create the continent of Hisui. Though I have my doubts, the story could well contain a shred of truth.
pokemon.regigigas.name: Regigigas
pokemon.regirock.flavor: Every bit of Regirock’s body is made of stone. As parts of its body erode, this Pokémon sticks rocks to itself to repair what’s been lost.
pokemon.regirock.name: Regirock
pokemon.registeel.flavor: Registeel’s body is made of a strange material that is flexible enough to stretch and shrink but also more durable than any metal.
pokemon.registeel.name: Registeel
pokemon.relicanth.flavor: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.
pokemon.relicanth.name: Relicanth
pokemon.rellor.flavor: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.
pokemon.rellor.name: Rellor
pokemon.remoraid.flavor: Spits water from its mouth with incredible accuracy. It captures Burmy by shooting them down off the branches from which they dangle.
pokemon.remoraid.name: Remoraid
pokemon.reshiram.flavor: Flames spew from its tail as it flies through the sky like a jet airplane. It’s said that this Pokémon will scorch the world.
pokemon.reshiram.name: Reshiram
pokemon.reuniclus.flavor: While it could use its psychic abilities in battle, this Pokémon prefers to swing its powerful arms around to beat opponents into submission.
pokemon.reuniclus.name: Reuniclus
pokemon.revavroom.flavor: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders—now numbering eight—to generate energy.
pokemon.revavroom.name: Revavroom
pokemon.rhydon.flavor: Rapidly rotates its horn to bore through bedrock. It swaggers around volcanic regions, protected from the lava's heat by its tough, armorlike hide.
pokemon.rhydon.name: Rhydon
pokemon.rhyhorn.flavor: Ludicrously strong—when it butts heads with a mountain, it is the mountain that shatters. But its short legs struggle with turns, and it is incapable of stopping unless it collides with something.
pokemon.rhyhorn.name: Rhyhorn
pokemon.rhyperior.flavor: This Pokémon evolved through use of a curious item. Its rocklike hide is composed of a mysterious substance and can withstand a blow from a masterwork sword with nary a scratch.
pokemon.rhyperior.name: Rhyperior
pokemon.ribombee.flavor: It makes pollen puffs from pollen and nectar. The puffs’ effects depend on the type of ingredients and how much of each one is used.
pokemon.ribombee.name: Ribombee
pokemon.ribombeetotem.name: Totem Ribombee
pokemon.rillaboom.flavor: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.
pokemon.rillaboom.name: Rillaboom
pokemon.rillaboomgmax.name: Gigantamax Rillaboom
pokemon.riolu.flavor: Though infantile in appearance, it has the mysterious ability to read the minds of humans. The pure of heart are met with Riolu's approval, while those of ill nature earn only its loathing.
pokemon.riolu.name: Riolu
pokemon.roaringmoon.flavor: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.
pokemon.roaringmoon.name: Roaring Moon
pokemon.rockruff.flavor: This Pokémon can bond very strongly with its Trainer, but it also has a habit of biting. Raising a Rockruff for a long time can be challenging.
pokemon.rockruff.name: Rockruff
pokemon.rockruffdusk.name: Own Tempo Rockruff
pokemon.roggenrola.flavor: It’s as hard as steel, but apparently a long soak in water will cause it to soften a bit.
pokemon.roggenrola.name: Roggenrola
pokemon.rolycoly.flavor: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.
pokemon.rolycoly.name: Rolycoly
pokemon.rookidee.flavor: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.
pokemon.rookidee.name: Rookidee
pokemon.roselia.flavor: Though beautiful, it has highly poisonous thorns. There is an old tradition in my homeland wherein one would send these thorns to an opponent to challenge them to a duel.
pokemon.roselia.name: Roselia
pokemon.roserade.flavor: Hidden within the bouquet on each hand are thorned whips loaded with virulent poison. Roserade moves gracefully as it corners its prey and mercilessly lashes them with its whips.
pokemon.roserade.name: Roserade
pokemon.rotom.flavor: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.
pokemon.rotom.name: Rotom
pokemon.rotomfan.name: Fan Rotom
pokemon.rotomfrost.name: Frost Rotom
pokemon.rotomheat.name: Heat Rotom
pokemon.rotommow.name: Mow Rotom
pokemon.rotomwash.name: Wash Rotom
pokemon.rowlet.flavor: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.
pokemon.rowlet.name: Rowlet
pokemon.rufflet.flavor: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.
pokemon.rufflet.name: Rufflet
pokemon.runerigus.flavor: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.
pokemon.runerigus.name: Runerigus
pokemon.sableye.flavor: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it’s believed that Sableye will steal people’s spirits away.
pokemon.sableye.name: Sableye
pokemon.sableyemega.name: Mega Sableye
pokemon.salamence.flavor: Salamence is an unusual Pokémon in that it was able to evolve a body with wings just by constantly wishing to be able to fly.
pokemon.salamence.name: Salamence
pokemon.salamencemega.name: Mega Salamence
pokemon.salandit.flavor: Its venom sacs produce a fluid that this Pokémon then heats up with the flame in its tail. This process creates Salandit’s poisonous gas.
pokemon.salandit.name: Salandit
pokemon.salazzle.flavor: Only female Salazzle exist. They emit a gas laden with pheromones to captivate male Salandit.
pokemon.salazzle.name: Salazzle
pokemon.salazzletotem.name: Totem Salazzle
pokemon.samurott.flavor: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.
pokemon.samurott.name: Samurott
pokemon.samurotthisui.name: Hisuian Samurott
pokemon.sandaconda.flavor: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.
pokemon.sandaconda.name: Sandaconda
pokemon.sandacondagmax.name: Gigantamax Sandaconda
pokemon.sandile.flavor: The desert gets cold at night, so when the sun sets, this Pokémon burrows deep into the sand and sleeps until sunrise.
pokemon.sandile.name: Sandile
pokemon.sandshrew.flavor: It loves to bathe in the grit of dry, sandy areas. By sand bathing, the Pokémon rids itself of dirt and moisture clinging to its body.
pokemon.sandshrew.name: Sandshrew
pokemon.sandshrewalola.name: Alolan Sandshrew
pokemon.sandslash.flavor: The drier the area Sandslash lives in, the harder and smoother the Pokémon’s spikes will feel when touched.
pokemon.sandslash.name: Sandslash
pokemon.sandslashalola.name: Alolan Sandslash
pokemon.sandygast.flavor: Grudges of the dead have possessed a mound of sand and become a Pokémon. Sandygast is fond of the shovel on its head.
pokemon.sandygast.name: Sandygast
pokemon.sandyshocks.flavor: No records exist of this Pokémon being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with a creature shown in an expedition journal.
pokemon.sandyshocks.name: Sandy Shocks
pokemon.sawk.flavor: If you see a Sawk training in the mountains in its single-minded pursuit of strength, it’s best to quietly pass by.
pokemon.sawk.name: Sawk
pokemon.sawsbuck.flavor: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.
pokemon.sawsbuck.name: Sawsbuck
pokemon.scatterbug.flavor: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.
pokemon.scatterbug.name: Scatterbug
pokemon.sceptile.flavor: The leaves growing on Sceptile’s body are very sharp edged. This Pokémon is very agile—it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe from above or behind.
pokemon.sceptile.name: Sceptile
pokemon.sceptilemega.name: Mega Sceptile
pokemon.scizor.flavor: Evolved by way of a curious item. The shell covering its body has been shown to be stronger than forged steel.
pokemon.scizor.name: Scizor
pokemon.scizormega.name: Mega Scizor
pokemon.scolipede.flavor: Scolipede latches on to its prey with the claws on its neck before slamming them into the ground and jabbing them with its claws’ toxic spikes.
pokemon.scolipede.name: Scolipede
pokemon.scolipedemega.name: Mega Scolipede
pokemon.scorbunny.flavor: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon’s body. Once that happens, it’s ready to fight at full power.
pokemon.scorbunny.name: Scorbunny
pokemon.scovillain.flavor: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.
pokemon.scovillain.name: Scovillain
pokemon.scovillainmega.name: Mega Scovillain
pokemon.scrafty.flavor: As halfhearted as this Pokémon’s kicks may seem, they pack enough power to shatter Conkeldurr’s concrete pillars.
pokemon.scrafty.name: Scrafty
pokemon.scraftymega.name: Mega Scrafty
pokemon.scraggy.flavor: If it locks eyes with you, watch out! Nothing and no one is safe from the reckless headbutts of this troublesome Pokémon.
pokemon.scraggy.name: Scraggy
pokemon.screamtail.flavor: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.
pokemon.screamtail.name: Scream Tail
pokemon.scyther.flavor: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.
pokemon.scyther.name: Scyther
pokemon.seadra.flavor: It’s the males that raise the offspring. While Seadra are raising young, the spines on their backs secrete thicker and stronger poison.
pokemon.seadra.name: Seadra
pokemon.seaking.flavor: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.
pokemon.seaking.name: Seaking
pokemon.sealeo.flavor: Its white whiskers are very sensitive. Sealeo will balance Spheal on the tip of its nose, checking its scent and its feel to be sure the Spheal is healthy.
pokemon.sealeo.name: Sealeo
pokemon.seedot.flavor: If it remains still, it looks just like a real nut. It delights in surprising foraging Pokémon.
pokemon.seedot.name: Seedot
pokemon.seel.flavor: Loves freezing-cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid climate of around 14 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokemon.seel.name: Seel
pokemon.seismitoad.flavor: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.
pokemon.seismitoad.name: Seismitoad
pokemon.sentret.flavor: When Sentret sleeps, it does so while another stands guard. The sentry wakes the others at the first sign of danger. When this Pokémon becomes separated from its pack, it becomes incapable of sleep due to fear.
pokemon.sentret.name: Sentret
pokemon.serperior.flavor: It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior’s noble eyes.
pokemon.serperior.name: Serperior
pokemon.servine.flavor: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.
pokemon.servine.name: Servine
pokemon.seviper.flavor: Seviper shares a generations-long feud with Zangoose. The scars on its body are evidence of vicious battles. This Pokémon attacks using its sword-edged tail.
pokemon.seviper.name: Seviper
pokemon.sewaddle.flavor: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.
pokemon.sewaddle.name: Sewaddle
pokemon.sharpedo.flavor: As soon as it catches the scent of prey, Sharpedo will jet seawater from its backside, hurtling toward the target to attack at 75 mph.
pokemon.sharpedo.name: Sharpedo
pokemon.sharpedomega.name: Mega Sharpedo
pokemon.shaymin.flavor: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.
pokemon.shaymin.name: Shaymin
pokemon.shayminsky.name: Sky Shaymin
pokemon.shedinja.flavor: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.
pokemon.shedinja.name: Shedinja
