pokemon.shelgon.flavor: This Pokémon has covered its body in a hard shell that has the same composition as bone. Shelgon stores energy for evolution.
pokemon.shelgon.name: Shelgon
pokemon.shellder.flavor: It swims facing backward by opening and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.
pokemon.shellder.name: Shellder
pokemon.shellos.flavor: Found in abundance on seashores bordering warm waters. Shellos are unexpectedly friendly and will crawl toward any person they see. Take care not to get coated in mucus!
pokemon.shellos.name: Shellos
pokemon.shelmet.flavor: When attacked, it tightly shuts the lid of its shell. This reaction fails to protect it from Karrablast, however, because they can still get into the shell.
pokemon.shelmet.name: Shelmet
pokemon.shieldon.flavor: Much remains unknown about this Pokémon, as few have ever seen it. However, we know that it is calm and dislikes conflict, and it enjoys polishing its face against trees and rocks.
pokemon.shieldon.name: Shieldon
pokemon.shiftry.flavor: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe’s mind and take preemptive action.
pokemon.shiftry.name: Shiftry
pokemon.shiinotic.flavor: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.
pokemon.shiinotic.name: Shiinotic
pokemon.shinx.flavor: Shakes its body to generate electricity. Its stature belies its aggression—one must be patient to tame this Pokémon.
pokemon.shinx.name: Shinx
pokemon.shroodle.flavor: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.
pokemon.shroodle.name: Shroodle
pokemon.shroomish.flavor: Shroomish live in damp soil in the dark depths of forests. They are often found keeping still under fallen leaves. This Pokémon feeds on compost that is made up of fallen, rotted leaves.
pokemon.shroomish.name: Shroomish
pokemon.shuckle.flavor: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.
pokemon.shuckle.name: Shuckle
pokemon.shuppet.flavor: It eats up emotions like malice, jealousy, and resentment, so some people are grateful for its presence.
pokemon.shuppet.name: Shuppet
pokemon.sigilyph.flavor: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians’ emissaries.
pokemon.sigilyph.name: Sigilyph
pokemon.silcoon.flavor: Wraps itself in thin strings of silk while it stores energy for evolution. It can't extend its limbs and its movement is slow, but its eyes keep a sharp lookout—Silcoon is always on guard.
pokemon.silcoon.name: Silcoon
pokemon.silicobra.flavor: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.
pokemon.silicobra.name: Silicobra
pokemon.silvally.flavor: A solid bond of trust between this Pokémon and its Trainer awakened the strength hidden within Silvally. It can change its type at will.
pokemon.silvally.name: Silvally
pokemon.simipour.flavor: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.
pokemon.simipour.name: Simipour
pokemon.simisage.flavor: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.
pokemon.simisage.name: Simisage
pokemon.simisear.flavor: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.
pokemon.simisear.name: Simisear
pokemon.sinistcha.flavor: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.
pokemon.sinistcha.name: Sinistcha
pokemon.sinistea.flavor: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.
pokemon.sinistea.name: Sinistea
pokemon.sirfetchd.flavor: Only Farfetch’d that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon’s leek withers, it will retire from combat.
pokemon.sirfetchd.name: Sirfetch’d
pokemon.sizzlipede.flavor: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.
pokemon.sizzlipede.name: Sizzlipede
pokemon.skarmory.flavor: The pointed feathers of these Pokémon are sharper than swords. Skarmory and Corviknight fight viciously over territory.
pokemon.skarmory.name: Skarmory
pokemon.skarmorymega.name: Mega Skarmory
pokemon.skeledirge.flavor: The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge’s head gained a soul.
pokemon.skeledirge.name: Skeledirge
pokemon.skiddo.flavor: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
pokemon.skiddo.name: Skiddo
pokemon.skiploom.flavor: Skiploom’s flower blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees Fahrenheit. How much the flower opens depends on the temperature. For that reason, this Pokémon is sometimes used as a thermometer.
pokemon.skiploom.name: Skiploom
pokemon.skitty.flavor: Skitty has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This Pokémon is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.
pokemon.skitty.name: Skitty
pokemon.skorupi.flavor: Its claws are not only razor-sharp but poisonous, making Skorupi a highly dangerous Pokémon. It seems to be weakened by cold temperatures, however.
pokemon.skorupi.name: Skorupi
pokemon.skrelp.flavor: It drifts in the ocean, blending in with floating seaweed. When other Pokémon come to feast on the seaweed, Skrelp feasts on them instead.
pokemon.skrelp.name: Skrelp
pokemon.skuntank.flavor: Sprays a poisonous fluid to take down prey. Sometimes, unable to stomach the stench of its own fluid, it leaves the bested prey uneaten.
pokemon.skuntank.name: Skuntank
pokemon.skwovet.flavor: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.
pokemon.skwovet.name: Skwovet
pokemon.slaking.flavor: Slaking spends all day lying down and lolling about. It eats grass growing within its reach. If it eats all the grass it can reach, this Pokémon reluctantly moves to another spot.
pokemon.slaking.name: Slaking
pokemon.slakoth.flavor: Slakoth lolls around for over 20 hours every day. Because it moves so little, it does not need much food. This Pokémon’s sole daily meal consists of just three leaves.
pokemon.slakoth.name: Slakoth
pokemon.sliggoo.flavor: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.
pokemon.sliggoo.name: Sliggoo
pokemon.sliggoohisui.name: Hisuian Sliggoo
pokemon.slitherwing.flavor: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.
pokemon.slitherwing.name: Slither Wing
pokemon.slowbro.flavor: Slowpoke became Slowbro when a Shellder bit on to its tail. Sweet flavors seeping from the tail make the Shellder feel as if its life is a dream.
pokemon.slowbro.name: Slowbro
pokemon.slowbrogalar.name: Galarian Slowbro
pokemon.slowbromega.name: Mega Slowbro
pokemon.slowking.flavor: Miraculously, this former Slowpoke’s latent intelligence was drawn out when Shellder poison raced through its brain.
pokemon.slowking.name: Slowking
pokemon.slowkinggalar.name: Galarian Slowking
pokemon.slowpoke.flavor: Slow-witted and oblivious, this Pokémon won’t feel any pain if its tail gets eaten. It won’t notice when its tail grows back, either.
pokemon.slowpoke.name: Slowpoke
pokemon.slowpokegalar.name: Galarian Slowpoke
pokemon.slugma.flavor: Molten magma courses throughout Slugma’s circulatory system. If this Pokémon is chilled, the magma cools and hardens. Its body turns brittle and chunks fall off, reducing its size.
pokemon.slugma.name: Slugma
pokemon.slurpuff.flavor: By taking in a person’s scent, it can sniff out their mental and physical condition. It’s hoped that this skill will have many medical applications.
pokemon.slurpuff.name: Slurpuff
pokemon.smeargle.flavor: The fluid of Smeargle’s tail secretions changes in the intensity of its hue as the Pokémon’s emotions change.
pokemon.smeargle.name: Smeargle
pokemon.smoliv.flavor: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.
pokemon.smoliv.name: Smoliv
pokemon.smoochum.flavor: If its face gets even slightly dirty, Smoochum will bathe immediately. But if its body gets dirty, Smoochum doesn’t really seem to care.
pokemon.smoochum.name: Smoochum
pokemon.sneasel.flavor: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.
pokemon.sneasel.name: Sneasel
pokemon.sneaselhisui.name: Hisuian Sneasel
pokemon.sneasler.flavor: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.
pokemon.sneasler.name: Sneasler
pokemon.snivy.flavor: Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.
pokemon.snivy.name: Snivy
pokemon.snom.flavor: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.
pokemon.snom.name: Snom
pokemon.snorlax.flavor: This glutton appears in villages without warning and devours the entirety of their rice granaries—such occurrences have long been counted among the gravest of disasters.
pokemon.snorlax.name: Snorlax
pokemon.snorlaxgmax.name: Gigantamax Snorlax
pokemon.snorunt.flavor: Arrives alongside the first snow. It's thought that homes Snorunt visit will prosper for many generations. By tradition, one might offer a lump of ice made from pure water at one's front door.
pokemon.snorunt.name: Snorunt
pokemon.snover.flavor: One is likely to encounter this Pokémon while out in the snow. There are stories of Snover appearing in human settlements but doing no harm—rather, they bond with the children.
pokemon.snover.name: Snover
pokemon.snubbull.flavor: It grows close to others easily and is also easily spoiled. The disparity between its face and its actions makes many young people wild about it.
pokemon.snubbull.name: Snubbull
pokemon.sobble.flavor: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won’t be able to resist weeping.
pokemon.sobble.name: Sobble
pokemon.solgaleo.flavor: When light radiates from its body, this Pokémon could almost appear to be the sun. It will dispel any darkness and light up the world.
pokemon.solgaleo.name: Solgaleo
pokemon.solosis.flavor: It communicates with others telepathically. Its body is encapsulated in liquid, but if it takes a heavy blow, the liquid will leak out.
pokemon.solosis.name: Solosis
pokemon.solrock.flavor: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.
pokemon.solrock.name: Solrock
pokemon.spearow.flavor: Inept at flying high. However, it can fly around very fast to protect its territory.
pokemon.spearow.name: Spearow
pokemon.spectrier.flavor: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s kicks are said to separate soul from body.
pokemon.spectrier.name: Spectrier
pokemon.spewpa.flavor: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
pokemon.spewpa.name: Spewpa
pokemon.spheal.flavor: During the season when drift ice approaches the shore, Spheal prefers living on the ice—where fewer predators lurk—rather than the land. Its fur retains heat superbly and resists harsh cold.
pokemon.spheal.name: Spheal
pokemon.spidops.flavor: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.
pokemon.spidops.name: Spidops
pokemon.spinarak.flavor: With threads from its mouth, it fashions sturdy webs that won’t break even if you set a rock on them.
pokemon.spinarak.name: Spinarak
pokemon.spinda.flavor: Its steps are shaky and stumbling. Walking for a long time makes it feel sick.
pokemon.spinda.name: Spinda
pokemon.spiritomb.flavor: It lays curses by thinking wicked thoughts. Writings tell that this Pokémon was born out of the assembly of five score and eight malevolent spirits.
pokemon.spiritomb.name: Spiritomb
pokemon.spoink.flavor: Spoink bounces around on its tail. The shock of its bouncing makes its heart pump. As a result, this Pokémon cannot afford to stop bouncing—if it stops, its heart will stop.
pokemon.spoink.name: Spoink
pokemon.sprigatito.flavor: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.
pokemon.sprigatito.name: Sprigatito
pokemon.spritzee.flavor: A scent pouch within this Pokémon’s body allows it to create various scents. A change in its diet will alter the fragrance it produces.
pokemon.spritzee.name: Spritzee
pokemon.squawkabilly.flavor: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.
pokemon.squawkabilly.name: Squawkabilly
pokemon.squawkabillyblue.name: Blue Plumage Squawkabilly
pokemon.squawkabillywhite.name: White Plumage Squawkabilly
pokemon.squawkabillyyellow.name: Yellow Plumage Squawkabilly
pokemon.squirtle.flavor: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.
pokemon.squirtle.name: Squirtle
pokemon.stakataka.flavor: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.
pokemon.stakataka.name: Stakataka
pokemon.stantler.flavor: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.
pokemon.stantler.name: Stantler
pokemon.staraptor.flavor: It has left the flock, having gained strength enough to survive on its own. The astounding force with which Staraptor flies through the air allows it to carry away large, burly targets.
pokemon.staraptor.name: Staraptor
pokemon.staraptormega.name: Mega Staraptor
pokemon.staravia.flavor: They form remarkably large flocks and are constantly fighting amongst themselves. I suspect that those with magnificent plumes on their heads are the strong ones.
pokemon.staravia.name: Staravia
pokemon.starly.flavor: They live in the fields and mountains, gathering in large flocks. Their cries are quite obnoxious. Though small, their wings are strong—a strike from them leaves pain that persists for a week.
pokemon.starly.name: Starly
pokemon.starmie.flavor: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.
pokemon.starmie.name: Starmie
pokemon.starmiemega.name: Mega Starmie
pokemon.staryu.flavor: If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you’ll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.
pokemon.staryu.name: Staryu
pokemon.steelix.flavor: This Pokémon evolved through use of a strange item. Its body is coated with steel powder and notably hard—not even diamond can leave so much as a scratch.
pokemon.steelix.name: Steelix
pokemon.steelixmega.name: Mega Steelix
pokemon.steenee.flavor: As it twirls like a dancer, a sweet smell spreads out around it. Anyone who inhales the scent will feel a surge of happiness.
pokemon.steenee.name: Steenee
pokemon.stonjourner.flavor: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun’s descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.
pokemon.stonjourner.name: Stonjourner
pokemon.stoutland.flavor: These Pokémon seem to enjoy living with humans. Even a Stoutland caught in the wild will warm up to people in about three days.
pokemon.stoutland.name: Stoutland
pokemon.stufful.flavor: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.
pokemon.stufful.name: Stufful
pokemon.stunfisk.flavor: Thanks to bacteria that lived in the mud flats with it, this Pokémon developed the organs it uses to generate electricity.
pokemon.stunfisk.name: Stunfisk
pokemon.stunfiskgalar.name: Galarian Stunfisk
pokemon.stunky.flavor: The poison that gushes from its aft end is accompanied by an utterly evil-smelling odor with such potency that one whiff can induce memory loss.
pokemon.stunky.name: Stunky
pokemon.sudowoodo.flavor: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.
pokemon.sudowoodo.name: Sudowoodo
pokemon.suicune.flavor: Suicune embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gracefulness. This Pokémon has the power to purify dirty water.
pokemon.suicune.name: Suicune
pokemon.sunflora.flavor: Sunflora converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.
pokemon.sunflora.name: Sunflora
pokemon.sunkern.flavor: Sunkern tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.
pokemon.sunkern.name: Sunkern
pokemon.surskit.flavor: If it’s in a pinch, it will secrete a sweet liquid from the tip of its head. Syrup made from gathering that liquid is tasty on bread.
pokemon.surskit.name: Surskit
pokemon.swablu.flavor: Its cottony wings are full of air, making them light and fluffy to the touch. Swablu takes diligent care of its wings.
pokemon.swablu.name: Swablu
pokemon.swadloon.flavor: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
pokemon.swadloon.name: Swadloon
pokemon.swalot.flavor: When Swalot spots prey, it spurts out a hideously toxic fluid from its pores and sprays the target. Once the prey has weakened, this Pokémon gulps it down whole with its cavernous mouth.
pokemon.swalot.name: Swalot
pokemon.swampert.flavor: Swampert is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This Pokémon also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.
pokemon.swampert.name: Swampert
pokemon.swampertmega.name: Mega Swampert
pokemon.swanna.flavor: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.
pokemon.swanna.name: Swanna
pokemon.swellow.flavor: Swellow flies high above our heads, making graceful arcs in the sky. This Pokémon dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. The hapless prey is tightly grasped by Swellow’s clawed feet, preventing escape.
pokemon.swellow.name: Swellow
pokemon.swinub.flavor: Swinub excels at sniffing out mushrooms buried beneath grass or snow. Since ancient times, the people of Hisui have often relied upon this skill.
pokemon.swinub.name: Swinub
pokemon.swirlix.flavor: It eats its own weight in sugar every day. If it doesn’t get enough sugar, it becomes incredibly grumpy.
pokemon.swirlix.name: Swirlix
pokemon.swoobat.flavor: Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out. Afterward, it won’t be able to fly for a little while.
pokemon.swoobat.name: Swoobat
pokemon.sylveon.flavor: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.
pokemon.sylveon.name: Sylveon
pokemon.tadbulb.flavor: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.
pokemon.tadbulb.name: Tadbulb
pokemon.taillow.flavor: Taillow courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be. This gutsy Pokémon will remain defiant even after a loss. On the other hand, it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.
pokemon.taillow.name: Taillow
pokemon.talonflame.flavor: Talonflame mainly preys upon other bird Pokémon. To intimidate opponents, it sends embers spewing from gaps between its feathers.
pokemon.talonflame.name: Talonflame
pokemon.tandemaus.flavor: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.
pokemon.tandemaus.name: Tandemaus
pokemon.tangela.flavor: It is cloaked entirely in blue vines, preventing any glimpse of its true identity. The vines impart a refreshing sensation when chewed—they're useful as a spice.
pokemon.tangela.name: Tangela
pokemon.tangrowth.flavor: Draped with long vines, it resembles a shrub in appearance. It swings bundles of vines as though they were arms, wrapping them around prey to ensnare them.
pokemon.tangrowth.name: Tangrowth
pokemon.tapubulu.flavor: Although it’s called a guardian deity, it’s violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.
pokemon.tapubulu.name: Tapu Bulu
pokemon.tapufini.flavor: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.
pokemon.tapufini.name: Tapu Fini
pokemon.tapukoko.flavor: Although it’s called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.
pokemon.tapukoko.name: Tapu Koko
pokemon.tapulele.flavor: It heals the wounds of people and Pokémon by sprinkling them with its sparkling scales. This guardian deity is worshiped on Akala.
pokemon.tapulele.name: Tapu Lele
pokemon.tarountula.flavor: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon’s natural enemy.
pokemon.tarountula.name: Tarountula
pokemon.tatsugiri.flavor: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.
pokemon.tatsugiri.name: Tatsugiri
pokemon.tatsugiricurlymega.name: Mega Curly Tatsugiri
pokemon.tatsugiridroopy.name: Droopy Form Tatsugiri
pokemon.tatsugiridroopymega.name: Mega Droopy Tatsugiri
pokemon.tatsugiristretchy.name: Stretchy Form Tatsugiri
pokemon.tatsugiristretchymega.name: Mega Stretchy Tatsugiri
pokemon.tauros.flavor: When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails, it’s a warning that the Pokémon is about to charge with astounding speed.
pokemon.tauros.name: Tauros
pokemon.taurospaldeaaqua.name: Paldean Tauros (Aqua Breed)
pokemon.taurospaldeablaze.name: Paldean Tauros (Blaze Breed)
pokemon.taurospaldeacombat.name: Paldean Tauros (Combat Breed)
pokemon.teddiursa.flavor: It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.
pokemon.teddiursa.name: Teddiursa
pokemon.tentacool.flavor: They fire beams from the glassy, magenta orbs that resemble eyes atop their heads, and they drift in shallow seas. During low tide, they can sometimes be found on beaches, desiccated.
pokemon.tentacool.name: Tentacool
pokemon.tentacruel.flavor: It has 80 tentacles, each with a venomous tip. These tentacles are also extendible, lengthening when Tentacruel attempts to catch prey. Use caution.
pokemon.tentacruel.name: Tentacruel
pokemon.tepig.flavor: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
pokemon.tepig.name: Tepig
pokemon.terapagos.flavor: Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon is the source of the Terastal phenomenon.
pokemon.terapagos.name: Terapagos
pokemon.terapagosstellar.name: Stellar Form Terapagos
pokemon.terapagosterastal.name: Terastal Form Terapagos
pokemon.terrakion.flavor: It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.
pokemon.terrakion.name: Terrakion
pokemon.thievul.flavor: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.
pokemon.thievul.name: Thievul
pokemon.throh.flavor: It performs throwing moves with first-rate skill. Over the course of many battles, Throh’s belt grows darker as it absorbs its wearer’s sweat.
pokemon.throh.name: Throh
pokemon.thundurus.flavor: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.
pokemon.thundurus.name: Thundurus
pokemon.thundurustherian.name: Therian Thundurus
pokemon.thwackey.flavor: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.
pokemon.thwackey.name: Thwackey
pokemon.timburr.flavor: It loves helping out with construction projects. It loves it so much that if rain causes work to halt, it swings its log around and throws a tantrum.
pokemon.timburr.name: Timburr
pokemon.tinglu.flavor: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.
pokemon.tinglu.name: Ting-Lu
pokemon.tinkatink.flavor: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.
pokemon.tinkatink.name: Tinkatink
pokemon.tinkaton.flavor: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.
pokemon.tinkaton.name: Tinkaton
pokemon.tinkatuff.flavor: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.
pokemon.tinkatuff.name: Tinkatuff
pokemon.tirtouga.flavor: This Pokémon inhabited ancient seas. Although it can only crawl, it still comes up onto land in search of prey.
pokemon.tirtouga.name: Tirtouga
pokemon.toedscool.flavor: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.
pokemon.toedscool.name: Toedscool
pokemon.toedscruel.flavor: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.
pokemon.toedscruel.name: Toedscruel
pokemon.togedemaru.flavor: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.
pokemon.togedemaru.name: Togedemaru
pokemon.togedemarutotem.name: Totem Togedemaru
pokemon.togekiss.flavor: Scant few have ever sighted this Pokémon. After studying what literature remains, I am certain Togekiss will reveal itself when peace reigns in the land.
pokemon.togekiss.name: Togekiss
pokemon.togepi.flavor: This ovate creature is frequently mistaken for a moving egg when encountered out in the fields or in the mountains. Its guileless smile soothes the soul.
pokemon.togepi.name: Togepi
pokemon.togetic.flavor: No records exist of Togetic being seen in the wilds. Rumors abound that it evolves under the loving care of a trusted human companion, upon whom the Pokémon then bestows great joy.
pokemon.togetic.name: Togetic
pokemon.torchic.flavor: Torchic sticks with its Trainer, following behind with unsteady steps. This Pokémon breathes fire of over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit, including fireballs that leave the foe scorched black.
pokemon.torchic.name: Torchic
pokemon.torkoal.flavor: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.
pokemon.torkoal.name: Torkoal
pokemon.tornadus.flavor: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.
pokemon.tornadus.name: Tornadus
pokemon.tornadustherian.name: Therian Tornadus
pokemon.torracat.flavor: In the midst of battle, the fire pouch on Torracat’s neck rings like a bell and produces stronger flames than usual.
pokemon.torracat.name: Torracat
pokemon.torterra.flavor: This remarkable, large-bodied Pokémon would serve beautifully as borrowed scenery for a garden, and its strength is peerless. Torterra roams the wilderness in search of clean water.
pokemon.torterra.name: Torterra
pokemon.totodile.flavor: Despite the smallness of its body, Totodile’s jaws are very powerful. While the Pokémon may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough power to cause serious injury.
pokemon.totodile.name: Totodile
pokemon.toucannon.flavor: They smack beaks with others of their kind to communicate. The strength and number of hits tell each other how they feel.
pokemon.toucannon.name: Toucannon
pokemon.toxapex.flavor: To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this Pokémon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing its body so it can capture its own body heat.
pokemon.toxapex.name: Toxapex
pokemon.toxel.flavor: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.
pokemon.toxel.name: Toxel
pokemon.toxicroak.flavor: Its crimson claws contain a virulent toxin. This toxin can be made into a tonic by diluting it, mixing it with several types of wild grass, and boiling it down over two days.
pokemon.toxicroak.name: Toxicroak
pokemon.toxtricity.flavor: When this Pokémon sounds as if it’s strumming a guitar, it’s actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.
pokemon.toxtricity.name: Toxtricity
pokemon.toxtricitygmax.name: Gigantamax Amped Toxtricity
pokemon.toxtricitylowkey.name: Low Key Toxtricity
pokemon.toxtricitylowkeygmax.name: Gigantamax Low Key Toxtricity
pokemon.tranquill.flavor: It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how far it travels, it can always find its way back to its master and its nest.
pokemon.tranquill.name: Tranquill
pokemon.trapinch.flavor: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.
pokemon.trapinch.name: Trapinch
pokemon.treecko.flavor: Treecko has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This Pokémon attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.
pokemon.treecko.name: Treecko
pokemon.trevenant.flavor: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokémon it shares its woods with, it’s kind.
pokemon.trevenant.name: Trevenant
pokemon.tropius.flavor: The bunches of fruit growing around the necks of Tropius in Alola are especially sweet compared to those in other regions.
pokemon.tropius.name: Tropius
pokemon.trubbish.flavor: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.
pokemon.trubbish.name: Trubbish
pokemon.trumbeak.flavor: It can bend the tip of its beak to produce over a hundred different cries at will.
pokemon.trumbeak.name: Trumbeak
pokemon.tsareena.flavor: This feared Pokémon has long, slender legs and a cruel heart. It shows no mercy as it stomps on its opponents.
pokemon.tsareena.name: Tsareena
pokemon.turtonator.flavor: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.
pokemon.turtonator.name: Turtonator
pokemon.turtwig.flavor: This Pokémon becomes more energetic the more sunlight there is. The part resembling a shell is similar to silt and is slightly damp and warm to the touch.
pokemon.turtwig.name: Turtwig
pokemon.tympole.flavor: Graceful ripples running across the water’s surface are a sure sign that Tympole are singing in high-pitched voices below.
pokemon.tympole.name: Tympole
pokemon.tynamo.flavor: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
pokemon.tynamo.name: Tynamo
pokemon.typenull.flavor: Rumor has it that the theft of top-secret research notes led to a new instance of this Pokémon being created in the Galar region.
pokemon.typenull.name: Type: Null
pokemon.typhlosion.flavor: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.
pokemon.typhlosion.name: Typhlosion
pokemon.typhlosionhisui.name: Hisuian Typhlosion
pokemon.tyranitar.flavor: Its body can’t be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.
pokemon.tyranitar.name: Tyranitar
pokemon.tyranitarmega.name: Mega Tyranitar
pokemon.tyrantrum.flavor: This Pokémon is from about 100,000,000 years ago. It has the presence of a king, vicious but magnificent.
pokemon.tyrantrum.name: Tyrantrum
pokemon.tyrogue.flavor: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.
pokemon.tyrogue.name: Tyrogue
pokemon.tyrunt.flavor: This is an ancient Pokémon, revived in modern times. It has a violent disposition, and it’ll tear apart anything it gets between its hefty jaws.
pokemon.tyrunt.name: Tyrunt
pokemon.umbreon.flavor: It is most active in the wee hours of the night, when moonlight bathes the land. Its large eyes can pierce the darkness and perceive prey with absolute clarity.
pokemon.umbreon.name: Umbreon
pokemon.unfezant.flavor: Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed.
pokemon.unfezant.name: Unfezant
pokemon.unown.flavor: It is hard to believe these strangely shaped Pokémon are truly living creatures. I've pointed out that the species' many forms resemble writing from other lands; no one will take me seriously.
pokemon.unown.name: Unown
pokemon.ursaluna.flavor: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
pokemon.ursaluna.name: Ursaluna
pokemon.ursalunabloodmoon.name: Bloodmoon Ursaluna
pokemon.ursaring.flavor: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.
pokemon.ursaring.name: Ursaring
pokemon.urshifu.flavor: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.
pokemon.urshifu.name: Urshifu
pokemon.urshifugmax.name: Gigantamax Single Strike Urshifu
pokemon.urshifurapidstrike.name: Rapid Strike Urshifu
pokemon.urshifurapidstrikegmax.name: Gigantamax Rapid Strike Urshifu
pokemon.uxie.flavor: A Pokémon feared but also respected for stealing away the memories of evildoers. I have found records that suggest Uxie holds dominion over knowledge.
pokemon.uxie.name: Uxie
pokemon.vanillish.flavor: By drinking pure water, it grows its icy body. This Pokémon can be hard to find on days with warm, sunny weather.
pokemon.vanillish.name: Vanillish
pokemon.vanillite.flavor: Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.
pokemon.vanillite.name: Vanillite
pokemon.vanilluxe.flavor: When its anger reaches a breaking point, this Pokémon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezes every creature around it, be they friend or foe.
pokemon.vanilluxe.name: Vanilluxe
pokemon.vaporeon.flavor: Tests show that its cells closely resemble water molecules, which perhaps explains its ability to conceal its form while submerged. I believe the origins of mermaid folklore lie with this Pokémon.
pokemon.vaporeon.name: Vaporeon
pokemon.varoom.flavor: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.
pokemon.varoom.name: Varoom
pokemon.veluza.flavor: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.
pokemon.veluza.name: Veluza
pokemon.venipede.flavor: Venipede and Sizzlipede are similar species, but when the two meet, a huge fight ensues.
pokemon.venipede.name: Venipede
pokemon.venomoth.flavor: The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove from skin. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.
pokemon.venomoth.name: Venomoth
pokemon.venonat.flavor: Its large eyes act as radar. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.
pokemon.venonat.name: Venonat
pokemon.venusaur.flavor: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.
pokemon.venusaur.name: Venusaur
pokemon.venusaurgmax.name: Gigantamax Venusaur
pokemon.venusaurmega.name: Mega Venusaur
pokemon.vespiquen.flavor: Commands its subjects to build its hive. It will dispatch any interlopers who dare sneak into its nest and use them as nourishment for itself.
pokemon.vespiquen.name: Vespiquen
pokemon.vibrava.flavor: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.
pokemon.vibrava.name: Vibrava
pokemon.victini.flavor: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
pokemon.victini.name: Victini
pokemon.victreebel.flavor: Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is dissolved in a day, bones and all.
pokemon.victreebel.name: Victreebel
pokemon.victreebelmega.name: Mega Victreebel
pokemon.vigoroth.flavor: Vigoroth is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can’t tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This Pokémon’s stress level rises if it can’t be moving constantly.
pokemon.vigoroth.name: Vigoroth
pokemon.vikavolt.flavor: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.
pokemon.vikavolt.name: Vikavolt
pokemon.vikavolttotem.name: Totem Vikavolt
pokemon.vileplume.flavor: It has the world’s largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.
pokemon.vileplume.name: Vileplume
pokemon.virizion.flavor: A legend tells of this Pokémon working together with Cobalion and Terrakion to protect the Pokémon of the Unova region.
pokemon.virizion.name: Virizion
pokemon.vivillon.flavor: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
pokemon.vivillon.name: Vivillon
pokemon.volbeat.flavor: With the arrival of night, Volbeat emits light from its tail. It communicates with others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of its light. This Pokémon is attracted by the sweet aroma of Illumise.
pokemon.volbeat.name: Volbeat
pokemon.volcanion.flavor: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.
pokemon.volcanion.name: Volcanion
pokemon.volcarona.flavor: Volcarona scatters burning scales. Some say it does this to start fires. Others say it’s trying to rescue those that suffer in the cold.
pokemon.volcarona.name: Volcarona
pokemon.voltorb.flavor: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.
pokemon.voltorb.name: Voltorb
pokemon.voltorbhisui.name: Hisuian Voltorb
pokemon.vullaby.flavor: It wears a bone to protect its rear. It often squabbles with others of its kind over particularly comfy bones.
pokemon.vullaby.name: Vullaby
pokemon.vulpix.flavor: In its belly burns a fire, which Vulpix spits out in the form of fireballs. When young, this Pokémon has but one white tail. As the Pokémon matures, this single tail splits into six.
pokemon.vulpix.name: Vulpix
pokemon.vulpixalola.name: Alolan Vulpix
pokemon.wailmer.flavor: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.
pokemon.wailmer.name: Wailmer
pokemon.wailord.flavor: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.
pokemon.wailord.name: Wailord
pokemon.walkingwake.flavor: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster mentioned in an old expedition journal.
pokemon.walkingwake.name: Walking Wake
pokemon.walrein.flavor: Its thick tusks are strong enough to shatter drift ice. They have been known to break, but they will grow back by the next year. The Hisui region is well known for these broken tusks.
pokemon.walrein.name: Walrein
pokemon.wartortle.flavor: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.
pokemon.wartortle.name: Wartortle
pokemon.watchog.flavor: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.
pokemon.watchog.name: Watchog
pokemon.wattrel.flavor: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.
pokemon.wattrel.name: Wattrel
pokemon.weavile.flavor: This species corners prey as a pack, under the guidance of a leader. Weavile displays increased cunning, leading me to speculate that its evolution caused further brain development.
pokemon.weavile.name: Weavile
pokemon.weedle.flavor: Beware of the sharp stinger on its head. It hides in grass and bushes where it eats leaves.
pokemon.weedle.name: Weedle
pokemon.weepinbell.flavor: When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is dissolved by strong acids.
pokemon.weepinbell.name: Weepinbell
pokemon.weezing.flavor: It mixes gases between its two bodies. It’s said that these Pokémon were seen all over the Galar region back in the day.
pokemon.weezing.name: Weezing
pokemon.weezinggalar.name: Galarian Weezing
pokemon.whimsicott.flavor: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it’ll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.
pokemon.whimsicott.name: Whimsicott
pokemon.whirlipede.flavor: This Pokémon spins itself rapidly and charges into its opponents. Its top speed is just over 60 mph.
pokemon.whirlipede.name: Whirlipede
pokemon.whiscash.flavor: Strikes its caudal fin against the swamp bed to shake the ground and startle its prey. It will then swallow the fleeing prey whole. People mistook this behavior as the cause of earthquakes.
pokemon.whiscash.name: Whiscash
pokemon.whismur.flavor: The cry of a Whismur is over 100 decibels. If you’re close to a Whismur when it lets out a cry, you’ll be stuck with an all-day headache.
pokemon.whismur.name: Whismur
pokemon.wigglytuff.flavor: The more air it takes in, the more it inflates. If opponents catch it in a bad mood, it will inflate itself to an enormous size to intimidate them.
pokemon.wigglytuff.name: Wigglytuff
pokemon.wiglett.flavor: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.
pokemon.wiglett.name: Wiglett
pokemon.wimpod.flavor: It’s nature’s cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.
pokemon.wimpod.name: Wimpod
pokemon.wingull.flavor: It makes its nest on sheer cliffs. Riding the sea breeze, it glides up into the expansive skies.
pokemon.wingull.name: Wingull
pokemon.wishiwashi.flavor: Individually, they’re incredibly weak. It’s by gathering up into schools that they’re able to confront opponents.
pokemon.wishiwashi.name: Wishiwashi
pokemon.wishiwashischool.name: School Wishiwashi
pokemon.wobbuffet.flavor: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to pump up its counterstrike.
pokemon.wobbuffet.name: Wobbuffet
pokemon.wochien.flavor: The grudge of a person punished for writing the king’s evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.
pokemon.wochien.name: Wo-Chien
pokemon.woobat.flavor: While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it’s evidence that Woobat live there.
pokemon.woobat.name: Woobat
pokemon.wooloo.flavor: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.
pokemon.wooloo.name: Wooloo
pokemon.wooper.flavor: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.
pokemon.wooper.name: Wooper
pokemon.wooperpaldea.name: Paldean Wooper
pokemon.wormadam.flavor: Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.
pokemon.wormadam.name: Wormadam
pokemon.wormadamsandy.name: Sandy Wormadam
pokemon.wormadamtrash.name: Trash Wormadam
pokemon.wugtrio.flavor: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.
pokemon.wugtrio.name: Wugtrio
pokemon.wurmple.flavor: Likes sap and is abundant in the wild. Why it evolves into various different forms is unknown. One cannot tell from a Wurmple's appearance which form it will take when it evolves.
pokemon.wurmple.name: Wurmple
pokemon.wynaut.flavor: It tends to move in a pack. Individuals squash against one another to toughen their spirits.
pokemon.wynaut.name: Wynaut
pokemon.wyrdeer.flavor: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.
pokemon.wyrdeer.name: Wyrdeer
pokemon.xatu.flavor: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.
pokemon.xatu.name: Xatu
pokemon.xerneas.flavor: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.
pokemon.xerneas.name: Xerneas
pokemon.xurkitree.flavor: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
pokemon.xurkitree.name: Xurkitree
pokemon.yamask.flavor: It wanders through ruins by night, carrying a mask that’s said to have been the face it had when it was still human.
pokemon.yamask.name: Yamask
pokemon.yamaskgalar.name: Galarian Yamask
pokemon.yamper.flavor: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.
pokemon.yamper.name: Yamper
pokemon.yanma.flavor: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.
pokemon.yanma.name: Yanma
pokemon.yanmega.flavor: Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey's most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.
pokemon.yanmega.name: Yanmega
pokemon.yungoos.flavor: Its stomach takes up most of its long torso. It’s a big eater, so the amount Trainers have to spend on its food is no laughing matter.
pokemon.yungoos.name: Yungoos
pokemon.yveltal.flavor: When this legendary Pokémon’s wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.
pokemon.yveltal.name: Yveltal
pokemon.zacian.flavor: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.
pokemon.zacian.name: Zacian
pokemon.zaciancrowned.name: Crowned Zacian
pokemon.zamazenta.flavor: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.
pokemon.zamazenta.name: Zamazenta
pokemon.zamazentacrowned.name: Crowned Zamazenta
pokemon.zangoose.flavor: Memories of battling its archrival Seviper are etched into every cell of Zangoose’s body. This Pokémon adroitly dodges attacks with incredible agility.
pokemon.zangoose.name: Zangoose
pokemon.zapdos.flavor: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.
pokemon.zapdos.name: Zapdos
pokemon.zapdosgalar.name: Galarian Zapdos
